name: Restaurant: dining & world cuisines
description: Sit-down Western dining and the world cuisines on New Zealand menus: cooking words, sauces, steak, seafood, cheese, desserts, wine and dishes from Italy to India.

words.zh: 炖/焖的（先煎上色，再加少量汤汁小火慢焖）
words.definition: Browned first, then cooked slowly in a small amount of liquid in a covered pot.

examples.en: Braised beef cheek with creamy mash and red wine jus.
examples.zh: 红酒汁焖牛脸肉配奶油土豆泥。

words.zh: 慢煮的（低温长时间烹调，肉很软）
words.definition: Cooked at a low heat for many hours until very tender.

examples.en: The slow-cooked lamb shoulder falls off the bone.
examples.zh: 慢煮羊肩肉软到一碰就脱骨。

words.zh: 油封（用油脂低温慢慢浸煮）
words.definition: Cooked slowly in fat, usually its own fat, at a low temperature until soft and rich.

examples.en: Confit duck leg with braised red cabbage.
examples.zh: 油封鸭腿配焖紫甘蓝。

words.note: 法语词，最后的 t 不发音。也可用于蔬菜，如 confit garlic（油封蒜）。

words.zh: 大火煎封的（表面快速煎上色，里面仍嫩）
words.definition: Cooked very quickly on a very hot surface so the outside browns and the inside stays soft.

examples.en: Seared scallops with cauliflower purée.
examples.zh: 香煎扇贝配花椰菜泥。

words.zh: 平底锅煎的
words.definition: Cooked in a frying pan with a little oil or butter.

examples.en: Pan-fried snapper with lemon butter sauce.
examples.zh: 香煎鲷鱼配柠檬黄油汁。

words.zh: 炭烤/扒的（有烤纹）
words.definition: Cooked on a very hot grill so the food gets dark stripes and a smoky taste.

examples.en: Chargrilled chicken thigh with salsa verde.
examples.zh: 炭烤鸡腿肉配青酱。

words.zh: 烘烤的（烤箱里烤）
words.definition: Cooked in an oven with dry heat, usually with a little oil.

examples.en: Roasted pumpkin, feta and walnut salad.
examples.zh: 烤南瓜、菲达奶酪和核桃沙拉。

words.note: roast 也可作形容词：roast chicken, roast veges。

words.zh: 水煮/低温浸煮的（在微滚的水、汤或酒里煮）
words.definition: Cooked gently in liquid that is hot but not boiling.

examples.en: Poached chicken breast with a herb salad.
examples.zh: 低温水煮鸡胸配香草沙拉。

examples.en: For dessert there's a pear poached in red wine.
examples.zh: 甜点有红酒煮梨。

words.zh: 烟熏的
words.definition: Flavoured and cooked or preserved with smoke from burning wood.

examples.en: Smoked brisket, served with pickles and white bread.
examples.zh: 烟熏牛胸肉，配酸黄瓜和白面包。

words.zh: 腌制的（用盐、糖等腌，不加热，生吃）
words.definition: Preserved with salt, sugar or smoke instead of being cooked.

examples.en: Beetroot-cured salmon with horseradish cream.
examples.zh: 甜菜根腌三文鱼配辣根奶油。

words.note: cured 一般不加热；marinated 是用酱汁腌入味后再烹调。

words.zh: 腌制入味的（用酱汁、香料泡）
words.definition: Soaked in a mix of oil, acid and spices before cooking to add flavour.

examples.en: Lamb skewers marinated in garlic, lemon and oregano.
examples.zh: 用蒜、柠檬和牛至腌过的羊肉串。

words.zh: 刷了亮面酱汁的
words.definition: Coated with a shiny, often sweet sauce that is brushed on while cooking.

examples.en: Honey-glazed carrots come with the roast.
examples.zh: 烤肉配蜂蜜糖渍胡萝卜。

words.zh: 酥脆的
words.definition: Pleasantly hard and crunchy on the outside.

examples.en: Crispy pork belly with apple slaw.
examples.zh: 脆皮五花肉配苹果卷心菜沙拉。

words.zh: 烤得有焦边的（故意烧出焦香）
words.definition: Cooked until the surface turns black in places, for a smoky flavour.

examples.en: Charred broccolini with chilli and lemon.
examples.zh: 炙烤西兰苔配辣椒和柠檬。

words.zh: 表皮烤/煎得起泡的
words.definition: Cooked over high heat until the skin bubbles and splits.

examples.en: Blistered cherry tomatoes on toasted sourdough.
examples.zh: 烤到起泡的小番茄放在烤酸面包上。

words.zh: 发酵的
words.definition: Changed by bacteria or yeast over time, giving a sour, strong flavour.

examples.en: Fermented chilli adds a nice kick to the dish.
examples.zh: 发酵辣椒让这道菜很有劲。

words.zh: 手撕的（慢煮到软烂后撕成丝）
words.definition: Cooked slowly until very soft, then torn into thin shreds.

examples.en: Pulled lamb shoulder with flatbread and yoghurt.
examples.zh: 手撕羊肩肉配薄饼和酸奶。

words.zh: 两次烹制的（如先煮/烤再煎脆）
words.definition: Cooked in two stages, often slowly first and then fried or roasted to crisp it.

examples.en: Twice-cooked pork belly with a ginger caramel.
examples.zh: 两次烹制的五花肉配姜味焦糖汁。

words.zh: 解构的（把传统菜拆开分别摆盘）
words.definition: A classic dish served with its parts separated on the plate instead of combined.

examples.en: The deconstructed cheesecake comes in a glass with crumbs on top.
examples.zh: 这款解构芝士蛋糕装在杯子里，上面撒着饼干碎。

words.zh: 浓缩汁（把汤汁、酒熬到变稠）
words.definition: A sauce made by boiling a liquid until much of it evaporates and it becomes thick.

examples.en: Duck breast with a port and cherry reduction.
examples.zh: 鸭胸配波特酒樱桃浓缩汁。

words.zh: 浸泡入味的（加了某种香味）
words.definition: Flavoured by soaking herbs, spices or fruit in a liquid.

examples.en: Bread with garlic-infused olive oil.
examples.zh: 面包配蒜香橄榄油。

words.zh: 什锦（几种同类食材的组合）
words.definition: A mix of several kinds of one type of food.

examples.en: Grilled fish with a medley of seasonal vegetables.
examples.zh: 烤鱼配时令什锦蔬菜。

words.zh: 垫在……上面（摆盘底层）
words.definition: Served on top of a layer of another food.

examples.en: Lamb rump on a bed of creamy polenta.
examples.zh: 羊臀肉放在奶油玉米糊上。

words.zh: 淋上（少量酱汁）
words.definition: With a thin stream of sauce or oil poured over the top.

examples.en: Burrata drizzled with basil oil and balsamic.
examples.zh: 布拉塔奶酪淋上罗勒油和意大利黑醋。

words.zh: 最后加上/点缀
words.definition: With a last ingredient added just before serving.

examples.en: Finished with shaved parmesan and fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 最后撒上刨片帕玛森奶酪和新鲜香草。

words.zh: 拌上/裹上（酱汁、黄油）
words.definition: Mixed so that every piece is coated with a sauce or seasoning.

examples.en: Prawns tossed in garlic and chilli butter.
examples.zh: 大虾拌蒜蓉辣椒黄油。

words.zh: 嫩煎/快炒的（少量油快速翻炒）
words.definition: Fried quickly in a little hot oil or butter while being moved around.

examples.en: Sautéed mushrooms and spinach on the side.
examples.zh: 旁边配炒蘑菇和菠菜。

words.zh: 火焰烧的（倒酒点火烧掉酒精）
words.definition: Cooked with alcohol that is set on fire for a short time.

examples.en: The bananas are flambéed at your table.
examples.zh: 香蕉在你桌边点火燃烧。

words.zh: 焦糖化的（煎烤到变褐、带甜味）
words.definition: Cooked until the natural sugars turn brown and sweet.

examples.en: Goat's cheese tart with caramelised onion.
examples.zh: 山羊奶酪挞配焦糖洋葱。

words.note: 新西兰/英国拼 caramelised，美国拼 caramelized。

words.zh: 刨成薄片的
words.definition: Cut into very thin slices with a sharp tool.

examples.en: Rocket salad with shaved parmesan.
examples.zh: 芝麻菜沙拉配刨片帕玛森奶酪。

words.zh: 切成细丝的
words.definition: Cut into long, thin strips like matchsticks.

examples.en: Topped with julienne carrot and cucumber.
examples.zh: 上面放胡萝卜丝和黄瓜丝。

words.zh: 打发的（打得轻盈蓬松）
words.definition: Beaten quickly until light and fluffy.

examples.en: Whipped feta with honey and toasted bread.
examples.zh: 打发菲达奶酪配蜂蜜和烤面包。

words.zh: 柴火烤的（用木柴烤炉）
words.definition: Cooked in an oven heated by burning wood.

examples.en: Our pizzas are cooked in a wood-fired oven.
examples.zh: 我们的披萨用柴火烤炉烤。

words.zh: 低温慢煮（真空袋恒温水浴）
words.definition: Sealed in a plastic bag and cooked for a long time in water at an exact, low temperature.

examples.en: The chicken is cooked sous vide, so it stays really juicy.
examples.zh: 鸡肉是低温慢煮的，所以特别多汁。

words.zh: 酿的/填馅的
words.definition: Filled with another food mixture before cooking.

examples.en: Chicken breast stuffed with spinach and ricotta.
examples.zh: 鸡胸酿菠菜和意大利乳清奶酪。

words.zh: 压制成块的（压紧后切块再煎脆）
words.definition: Pressed flat under weight after cooking, then cut into neat blocks.

examples.en: Pressed pork belly with crackling and apple purée.
examples.zh: 压制五花肉配脆皮和苹果泥。

words.zh: 手切的
words.definition: Cut by hand in the kitchen, not by a machine.

examples.en: Hand-cut chips with rosemary salt.
examples.zh: 手切薯条配迷迭香盐。

words.zh: 传统老品种的（多指番茄、胡萝卜）
words.definition: From an old variety of plant, often colourful and full of flavour.

examples.en: Heirloom tomato salad with burrata.
examples.zh: 传统品种番茄沙拉配布拉塔奶酪。

words.zh: （肉的）圆形厚片
words.definition: Small round thick pieces of meat.

examples.en: Pork medallions with a creamy mustard sauce.
examples.zh: 猪肉圆片配奶油芥末汁。

words.zh: 单点（每道菜分别定价）
words.definition: Ordering separate dishes from the menu, each with its own price, rather than a set meal.

examples.en: We can do the tasting menu or order à la carte.
examples.zh: 我们可以点品鉴套餐，也可以单点。

words.note: 与 set menu / tasting menu（固定套餐）相对。

words.zh: 原汁肉汁（稀薄、清亮的肉汁酱）
words.definition: A thin, rich sauce made from the juices of cooked meat, often with wine.

examples.en: Eye fillet with potato gratin and red wine jus.
examples.zh: 菲力牛排配焗土豆和红酒肉汁。

words.note: 法语词，s 不发音。比 gravy 稀、清；gravy 通常用面粉勾芡，较稠。

words.zh: 黑胡椒汁
words.definition: A creamy sauce with crushed black or green peppercorns, usually for steak.

examples.en: Which sauce would you like with your steak: peppercorn, mushroom or béarnaise?
examples.zh: 牛排要配什么酱：黑椒汁、蘑菇汁还是贝亚恩酱？

words.zh: 蘑菇汁
words.definition: A creamy sauce made with cooked mushrooms.

examples.en: I'll have the scotch fillet with mushroom sauce.
examples.zh: 我要肉眼牛排配蘑菇汁。

words.zh: 贝亚恩酱（黄油蛋黄酱加龙蒿，配牛排）
words.definition: A rich, thick butter and egg yolk sauce flavoured with tarragon and vinegar, served with steak.

examples.en: Can I have the béarnaise on the side?
examples.zh: 贝亚恩酱能单独放一边吗？

words.zh: 阿根廷青酱（欧芹、蒜、醋、油，配烤肉）
words.definition: A green Argentinian sauce of parsley, garlic, vinegar and oil, served with grilled meat.

examples.en: Flank steak with chimichurri and charred corn.
examples.zh: 牛腹排配阿根廷青酱和烤玉米。

words.zh: 意式青酱（香草、刺山柑、橄榄油，偏酸）
words.definition: A sharp green sauce of chopped herbs, capers, garlic and olive oil.

examples.en: Grilled market fish with salsa verde.
examples.zh: 烤当日鲜鱼配意式青酱。

words.note: 意大利 salsa verde 是香草酱；墨西哥 salsa verde 是青番茄辣酱，看菜系判断。

words.zh: 青酱（罗勒、松子、帕玛森、橄榄油）
words.definition: A green sauce of crushed basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic and olive oil.

examples.en: Linguine with basil pesto and cherry tomatoes.
examples.zh: 罗勒青酱扁意面配小番茄。

words.note: 含松子和奶酪，坚果过敏要注意。

words.zh: 油醋汁
words.definition: A simple salad dressing of oil and vinegar, often with mustard.

examples.en: The salad comes with a light lemon vinaigrette.
examples.zh: 沙拉配清爽的柠檬油醋汁。

words.zh: 沙拉酱/调味汁
words.definition: A sauce poured over a salad.

examples.en: Could I have the dressing on the side?
examples.zh: 沙拉酱可以分开放吗？

words.zh: 果蓉酱/蔬菜细酱（过滤后的顺滑酱汁）
words.definition: A smooth, thin sauce of puréed and strained fruit or vegetables.

examples.en: Panna cotta with raspberry coulis.
examples.zh: 意式奶冻配覆盆子果酱。

words.zh: 意式柠檬香草碎（欧芹、蒜、柠檬皮）
words.definition: A fresh topping of chopped parsley, garlic and lemon zest.

examples.en: Osso buco finished with gremolata.
examples.zh: 意式炖牛膝最后撒上柠檬香草碎。

words.zh: 白黄油酱（白酒、红葱、黄油，配鱼）
words.definition: A rich French sauce of butter, white wine and shallots, usually for fish.

examples.en: Pan-fried hāpuku with a lemon beurre blanc.
examples.zh: 香煎新西兰石斑配柠檬白黄油酱。

words.zh: 焦香黄油（黄油煮至微褐带坚果香）
words.definition: Butter cooked until it turns golden brown and smells nutty.

examples.en: Gnocchi with brown butter and crispy sage.
examples.zh: 土豆团子配焦香黄油和脆鼠尾草。

words.note: 法语叫 beurre noisette（bur nwah-ZET）。

words.zh: 浓缩褐色高汤酱（法式浓肉汁）
words.definition: A very rich, glossy brown sauce made by slowly reducing meat stock.

examples.en: Beef short rib with a red wine demi-glace.
examples.zh: 牛小排配红酒浓缩肉汁。

words.zh: 西班牙红椒坚果酱
words.definition: A Spanish sauce of roasted red peppers, nuts, garlic and olive oil.

examples.en: Grilled octopus with romesco and potatoes.
examples.zh: 烤章鱼配红椒坚果酱和土豆。

words.zh: 第戎芥末（法式顺滑黄芥末）
words.definition: A smooth, strong French mustard.

examples.en: The steak comes with Dijon mustard and fries.
examples.zh: 牛排配第戎芥末和薯条。

words.note: wholegrain mustard 是带芥末籽颗粒的芥末酱。

words.zh: 辣根（白色的冲辣根茎，配烤牛肉）
words.definition: A strong, hot root, grated or made into a creamy sauce for beef or fish.

examples.en: Roast beef with horseradish cream.
examples.zh: 烤牛肉配辣根奶油酱。

words.note: 西餐里的 horseradish 是白色的；寿司的 wasabi 常常就是染绿的辣根。

words.zh: 薄荷酱（配烤羊肉的酸甜薄荷汁）
words.definition: A thin, sweet-sour sauce of chopped mint and vinegar, served with roast lamb.

examples.en: Roast lamb isn't complete without mint sauce.
examples.zh: 烤羊肉一定要配薄荷酱。

words.zh: 刺山柑（腌渍小花蕾，咸酸）
words.definition: Small salty, sour flower buds kept in vinegar or salt.

examples.en: Smoked salmon with capers and red onion.
examples.zh: 烟熏三文鱼配刺山柑和红洋葱。

words.zh: 松露（昂贵的地下菌，香气浓）
words.definition: A rare, expensive underground fungus with a strong, earthy smell.

examples.en: The truffle fries are worth trying.
examples.zh: 松露薯条值得一试。

words.note: truffle oil 多是人工香精调味油；巧克力 truffle 是松露形状的巧克力球。

words.zh: 蓉/泥（打得很细滑）
words.definition: Food that has been blended until completely smooth.

examples.en: Pork cutlet with a parsnip purée.
examples.zh: 猪排配欧洲防风泥。

words.zh: 土豆泥
words.definition: Potatoes boiled and crushed with butter and milk until soft.

examples.en: Sausages with mash and onion gravy.
examples.zh: 香肠配土豆泥和洋葱肉汁。

words.note: 正式写法 mashed potato；菜单常简写 mash。

words.zh: 焗烤菜（表面有焦黄芝士或面包屑）
words.definition: A dish topped with cheese or breadcrumbs and baked until golden on top.

examples.en: Steak with potato gratin and greens.
examples.zh: 牛排配焗土豆和青菜。

words.zh: 法式奶油焗土豆片
words.definition: Thin slices of potato baked slowly in cream and garlic.

examples.en: Lamb rack with dauphinoise potatoes.
examples.zh: 羊排配法式奶油焗土豆。

words.zh: 瑞士薯饼（土豆丝煎成的圆饼）
words.definition: A Swiss cake of grated potato fried until crisp on both sides.

examples.en: Smoked salmon on a potato rösti.
examples.zh: 烟熏三文鱼放在土豆丝饼上。

words.zh: 风琴土豆（切成薄片不切断再烤）
words.definition: Whole potatoes cut into thin slices not quite through, then roasted until crisp.

examples.en: Hasselback potatoes with garlic butter.
examples.zh: 风琴烤土豆配蒜香黄油。

words.zh: 鸭油烤土豆
words.definition: Potatoes roasted in duck fat so they are very crisp outside.

examples.en: A side of duck fat potatoes for the table, please.
examples.zh: 请给我们桌来一份鸭油烤土豆。

words.zh: 玉米糊/玉米粥（可软糊或煎成块）
words.definition: Cooked cornmeal, served soft like porridge or set and fried in pieces.

examples.en: Braised beef on soft polenta.
examples.zh: 焖牛肉配软玉米糊。

words.note: polenta chips / fries 是把玉米糊凝固后切条炸的。

words.zh: 卷心菜丝沙拉
words.definition: A salad of shredded raw cabbage, often with carrot and a creamy dressing.

examples.en: Pulled pork bun with apple slaw.
examples.zh: 手撕猪肉包配苹果卷心菜沙拉。

words.note: slaw 是 coleslaw 的简称。

words.zh: 约克郡布丁（烤牛肉配的空心面糊小饼，不是甜点）
words.definition: A puffy baked batter served with roast beef and gravy, not a dessert.

examples.en: The Sunday roast comes with Yorkshire pudding.
examples.zh: 周日烤肉配约克郡布丁。

words.note: 英式 pudding 不一定是甜点。

words.zh: 奶油菠菜
words.definition: Spinach cooked in a creamy sauce.

examples.en: We'll share a side of creamed spinach.
examples.zh: 我们要一份奶油菠菜一起吃。

words.zh: 时令青菜
words.definition: Whatever green vegetables are in season, usually steamed or sautéed.

examples.en: The fish comes with seasonal greens.
examples.zh: 鱼配时令青菜。

words.zh: 欧洲防风（白色像胡萝卜的甜根菜）
words.definition: A long cream-coloured root vegetable like a carrot, with a sweet taste.

examples.en: Roast parsnip and honey soup.
examples.zh: 烤欧洲防风蜂蜜汤。

words.zh: 根芹（芹菜的大圆根，白色）
words.definition: A large, round, knobbly root with a mild celery taste.

examples.en: Venison with celeriac purée.
examples.zh: 鹿肉配根芹泥。

words.zh: 茴香头/球茎茴香（有八角味的白色球茎）
words.definition: A white bulb vegetable with a light aniseed taste.

examples.en: Shaved fennel and orange salad.
examples.zh: 茴香薄片橙子沙拉。

words.zh: 红葱头（小洋葱，味更细腻）
words.definition: A small, mild, sweet type of onion.

examples.en: The sauce is made with shallots and white wine.
examples.zh: 这酱汁用红葱头和白葡萄酒做。

words.note: 澳洲有些地方把葱叫 shallot；新西兰菜单上一般指红葱头。

words.zh: 意大利黑醋（甜酸浓郁）
words.definition: A dark, sweet and sour Italian vinegar made from grapes.

examples.en: Strawberries with balsamic and black pepper.
examples.zh: 草莓配意大利黑醋和黑胡椒。

words.term: how would you like it cooked?
words.zh: 您的牛排要几分熟？
words.definition: What the waiter asks to find out how well cooked you want your steak.

examples.en: How would you like your steak cooked? — Medium rare, please.
examples.zh: 您的牛排要几分熟？——三分熟，谢谢。

words.note: 英语不用“几分熟”，直接回答 rare / medium rare / medium / medium well / well done。

words.zh: 近乎全生（表面快速煎一下，里面凉的）
words.definition: A steak seared very briefly on the outside, still cold and red inside.

examples.en: I like my steak blue, just seared on the outside.
examples.zh: 我的牛排要近乎全生，外面煎一下就好。

words.note: 比 rare 还生，不是所有餐厅都做。

words.zh: 一分熟（中心红色，微温）
words.definition: A steak cooked only a little, with a red, cool centre.

examples.en: Rare for me, please, and medium for my wife.
examples.zh: 我要一分熟，我太太要五分熟。

words.zh: 三分熟（中心粉红偏红，最常见推荐）
words.definition: A steak with a warm, pink-red centre; many chefs recommend it.

examples.en: The chef recommends the wagyu cooked medium rare.
examples.zh: 主厨建议和牛煎到三分熟。

words.note: 中文“三分熟、五分熟”与英文分级只是大致对应。

words.zh: 五分熟（中心粉红）
words.definition: A steak with a pink, warm centre and no red.

examples.en: A medium scotch fillet with peppercorn sauce, please.
examples.zh: 一份五分熟的肉眼牛排配黑椒汁。

words.zh: 七分熟（中心只剩一点粉色）
words.definition: A steak cooked until only a little pink is left in the middle.

examples.en: Could I get the rump medium well?
examples.zh: 臀肉牛排能做七分熟吗？

words.zh: 全熟
words.definition: A steak cooked all the way through with no pink inside.

examples.en: I'd like it well done, please — no pink at all.
examples.zh: 我要全熟，一点粉色都不要。

words.note: 有些高级餐厅不建议做全熟的和牛或菲力。

words.zh: 肉眼牛排（新西兰叫法，即 ribeye）
words.definition: A tender, well-marbled boneless steak from the rib section; called ribeye in the US.

examples.en: The 300g scotch fillet is our most popular steak.
examples.zh: 300克肉眼是我们最受欢迎的牛排。

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲叫 scotch fillet，美国叫 ribeye。带骨的常叫 ribeye on the bone。

words.zh: 西冷（外脊）
words.definition: A popular steak from the back of the cow, with a strip of fat along one side.

examples.en: The sirloin has a nice strip of fat on the edge.
examples.zh: 西冷边上有一条漂亮的肥边。

words.note: 新西兰的 sirloin 相当于美国的 strip steak / New York strip。

words.zh: 西冷（新西兰/澳洲的叫法）
words.definition: In New Zealand and Australia, a boneless sirloin steak.

examples.en: Is the porterhouse on or off the bone?
examples.zh: 这块 porterhouse 是带骨的还是去骨的？

words.note: 陷阱：新西兰/澳洲 porterhouse = 去骨西冷；美国 porterhouse = 大块 T 骨牛排。

words.zh: 菲力（牛里脊，最嫩）
words.definition: The most tender, lean steak, cut from the tenderloin.

examples.en: The eye fillet is lean and very tender.
examples.zh: 菲力很瘦，非常嫩。

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲叫 eye fillet，美国叫 tenderloin 或 filet mignon。

words.zh: 臀肉牛排（味浓，稍有嚼劲，价格实惠）
words.definition: A flavourful, slightly firmer steak from the back of the cow, usually cheaper.

examples.en: Rump steak, chips and salad for $28.
examples.zh: 臀肉牛排配薯条沙拉，28元。

words.zh: T 骨牛排（一边西冷一边菲力）
words.definition: A large steak with a T-shaped bone, with sirloin on one side and fillet on the other.

examples.en: The T-bone is big enough for two.
examples.zh: 这块 T 骨牛排够两个人吃。

words.zh: 战斧牛排（带长骨的大块肉眼）
words.definition: A very large ribeye steak with the long rib bone left on.

examples.en: We're sharing the 1.2kg tomahawk for the table.
examples.zh: 我们全桌分享那块1.2公斤的战斧牛排。

words.zh: 牛腹排（纤维明显，适合切片）
words.definition: A long, flat, flavourful cut from the belly, usually sliced thinly across the grain.

examples.en: Sliced flank steak with chimichurri.
examples.zh: 切片牛腹排配阿根廷青酱。

words.zh: 和牛（大理石花纹多，很嫩）
words.definition: A Japanese breed of cattle whose beef has a lot of fat marbling and is very tender.

examples.en: Is the wagyu from Japan or Australia?
examples.zh: 这和牛是日本的还是澳洲的？

words.note: 菜单常标 marble score（MB 4+ 等），分数越高油花越多。

words.zh: 安格斯牛（常见优质肉牛品种）
words.definition: A breed of cattle known for good, well-marbled beef.

examples.en: All our burgers use 100% Angus beef.
examples.zh: 我们所有汉堡都用100%安格斯牛肉。

words.zh: 草饲的
words.definition: From animals that ate grass in fields rather than grain.

examples.en: Our beef is grass-fed and from Hawke's Bay.
examples.zh: 我们的牛肉是草饲的，来自霍克斯湾。

words.note: 新西兰大多数牛羊都是草饲。

words.zh: 谷饲的（肉更肥嫩，油花多）
words.definition: From animals fed grain for a period, usually giving fattier, more marbled meat.

examples.en: The grain-fed ribeye has more marbling.
examples.zh: 谷饲肉眼的油花更多。

words.zh: 干式熟成的（风干熟成，风味更浓）
words.definition: Beef hung in a cold, dry room for weeks to make it more tender and flavourful.

examples.en: Our 45-day dry-aged sirloin is cut to order.
examples.zh: 我们的45天干式熟成西冷现点现切。

words.zh: 大理石花纹（肉里的细脂肪纹）
words.definition: Thin lines of fat inside meat that make it juicy and tender.

examples.en: Look at the marbling on that wagyu.
examples.zh: 看那块和牛的油花。

words.zh: 带骨的
words.definition: Cooked and served with the bone still in the meat.

examples.en: The ribeye on the bone takes about 25 minutes.
examples.zh: 带骨肉眼大约要25分钟。

words.zh: 羊排（一整排带骨小羊排）
words.definition: A row of lamb ribs with tender meat, cooked as one piece and cut into cutlets.

examples.en: Herb-crusted lamb rack, served pink.
examples.zh: 香草脆皮羊排，做成粉嫩的。

words.note: 也写作 rack of lamb。切成单根叫 lamb cutlets。

words.zh: 单根羊排
words.definition: Single lamb ribs with a small round piece of meat on the end of the bone.

examples.en: The kids love the crumbed lamb cutlets.
examples.zh: 孩子们很爱吃面包糠炸羊排。

words.zh: 羊腿腱（小腿，慢炖很软）
words.definition: The lower part of the lamb's leg, usually braised for hours until very tender.

examples.en: Slow-braised lamb shank on mash.
examples.zh: 慢炖羊腱放在土豆泥上。

words.zh: 羊臀肉（嫩而有味，通常做粉嫩）
words.definition: A tender, boneless cut from the top of the lamb's back leg.

examples.en: Lamb rump with roast pumpkin and salsa verde.
examples.zh: 羊臀肉配烤南瓜和意式青酱。

words.zh: 一岁多的羊（比羔羊大，比成羊嫩）
words.definition: A young sheep between about one and two years old; its meat is stronger than lamb.

examples.en: Tonight's special is slow-roasted hogget shoulder.
examples.zh: 今晚特色菜是慢烤一岁羊肩。

words.note: 新西兰常用词：lamb 羔羊（一岁内）→ hogget → mutton 成年羊。

words.zh: 五花肉
words.definition: Fatty, boneless meat from the belly of a pig, often cooked until crispy.

examples.en: Crispy pork belly with apple and fennel slaw.
examples.zh: 脆皮五花肉配苹果茴香沙拉。

words.zh: 烤脆猪皮
words.definition: The crunchy, salty skin of roast pork.

examples.en: The best part of the roast pork is the crackling.
examples.zh: 烤猪肉最好吃的就是那层脆皮。

words.zh: 牛小排（多慢炖或韩式烤）
words.definition: A meaty, fatty cut of beef rib, often slow-cooked until very soft.

examples.en: Twelve-hour braised short rib with a smoky glaze.
examples.zh: 十二小时慢炖牛小排配烟熏酱。

words.zh: 牛胸肉（慢烟熏/慢炖）
words.definition: A tough cut from the chest of the cow that becomes tender after long, slow cooking.

examples.en: Smoked brisket, sliced thick, with pickles.
examples.zh: 烟熏牛胸肉厚切，配酸黄瓜。

words.zh: 牛脸肉（慢炖后软糯）
words.definition: Meat from the cow's face that becomes very soft when braised.

examples.en: The beef cheek is cooked for eight hours.
examples.zh: 牛脸肉要炖八个小时。

words.zh: 牛尾
words.definition: The tail of a cow, cooked slowly for stews and soups.

examples.en: Braised oxtail with polenta.
examples.zh: 焖牛尾配玉米糊。

words.zh: 鹿肉（新西兰常见养殖鹿肉）
words.definition: Meat from deer; in New Zealand it is usually farmed.

examples.en: The venison is best served medium rare.
examples.zh: 鹿肉最好做到三分熟。

words.note: 新西兰有大量养殖鹿，鹿肉很瘦，煎太熟会柴。

words.zh: 鸭胸
words.definition: The lean breast meat of a duck, usually cooked pink with crispy skin.

examples.en: Pan-roasted duck breast with cherries.
examples.zh: 煎烤鸭胸配樱桃。

words.note: 鸭胸通常做成粉嫩的，和鸡胸不同。

words.zh: 油封鸭腿
words.definition: A duck leg cooked slowly in its own fat, then crisped.

examples.en: Confit duck leg with lentils and orange.
examples.zh: 油封鸭腿配扁豆和橙子。

words.zh: 鸡腿肉（去骨，比鸡胸嫩、多汁）
words.definition: Darker, juicier meat from the top of the chicken's leg.

examples.en: Can I swap the breast for chicken thigh?
examples.zh: 能把鸡胸换成鸡腿肉吗？

words.note: chicken breast 鸡胸（瘦）；drumstick 鸡小腿；thigh 鸡大腿。

words.zh: 带翅根的鸡胸（去骨，保留一小节翅骨）
words.definition: A chicken breast with the skin on and the first wing bone still attached.

examples.en: Chicken supreme with mushroom sauce.
examples.zh: 带翅根鸡胸配蘑菇汁。

words.zh: 内脏（下水）
words.definition: The organs of an animal used as food, such as liver, kidney and heart.

examples.en: The chef loves cooking offal, so check the specials.
examples.zh: 主厨喜欢做内脏菜，可以看看特色菜。

words.zh: 小牛/羔羊胸腺（是内脏，不是甜面包）
words.definition: The thymus or pancreas of a young animal, a soft and rich type of offal.

examples.en: Crispy lamb sweetbreads with capers.
examples.zh: 香脆羔羊胸腺配刺山柑。

words.note: 陷阱：sweetbreads 不是面包，也不甜。

words.zh: 骨髓
words.definition: The soft fatty part inside large bones, roasted and spread on toast.

examples.en: Roasted bone marrow with parsley salad and toast.
examples.zh: 烤骨髓配欧芹沙拉和吐司。

words.zh: 小牛肉
words.definition: Meat from a young calf, pale and tender.

examples.en: Veal schnitzel with lemon.
examples.zh: 炸小牛肉排配柠檬。

words.zh: 鹌鹑
words.definition: A small bird with tender dark meat.

examples.en: Chargrilled quail with pomegranate.
examples.zh: 炭烤鹌鹑配石榴。

words.zh: 惠灵顿牛排（菲力包酥皮烤）
words.definition: Beef fillet coated with mushroom paste and wrapped in pastry, then baked.

examples.en: The beef Wellington is for two and takes 40 minutes.
examples.zh: 惠灵顿牛排是双人份，要等40分钟。

words.zh: 烤肉拼盘（牛排、香肠、羊排等）
words.definition: A plate of different grilled meats, such as steak, sausage, lamb chop and bacon.

examples.en: He ordered the mixed grill and couldn't finish it.
examples.zh: 他点了烤肉拼盘，没吃完。

words.zh: 海陆双拼（牛排配海鲜）
words.definition: A steak served together with seafood such as prawns or crayfish.

examples.en: Surf and turf: eye fillet with garlic prawns.
examples.zh: 海陆双拼：菲力配蒜蓉大虾。

words.zh: 当日市场鱼（每天进什么鱼就用什么）
words.definition: Whatever fresh fish the restaurant bought that day; the waiter will tell you which.

examples.en: What's the market fish today? — It's snapper.
examples.zh: 今天的市场鱼是什么？——是鲷鱼。

words.note: 价格可能写 MP（market price，时价）。

words.zh: 帝王鲑（新西兰养殖三文鱼，油脂丰富）
words.definition: A large, rich, oily salmon farmed in New Zealand.

examples.en: New Zealand king salmon sashimi, six pieces.
examples.zh: 新西兰帝王鲑刺身，六片。

words.note: salmon 的 l 不发音。

words.zh: 新西兰石斑（大型深海白肉鱼）
words.definition: A large deep-sea New Zealand fish with thick, firm white flesh; also called groper.

examples.en: Grilled hāpuku with crushed potatoes.
examples.zh: 烤新西兰石斑配压碎土豆。

words.note: 毛利语名，英文也叫 groper / grouper。

words.zh: 海鲂（身上有黑色圆斑的扁鱼）
words.definition: A flat sea fish with a dark spot on its side and delicate white flesh.

examples.en: John Dory with a champagne beurre blanc.
examples.zh: 海鲂配香槟白黄油酱。

words.zh: 黄尾鰤（常生吃，像日料的油甘鱼）
words.definition: A large, firm, oily fish, very good raw or seared.

examples.en: Kingfish crudo with lime and chilli.
examples.zh: 生鰤鱼片配青柠和辣椒。

words.zh: 柠檬汁腌生鱼（拉美做法）
words.definition: Raw fish "cooked" in lime or lemon juice with onion, chilli and herbs.

examples.en: Snapper ceviche with coconut and lime.
examples.zh: 椰奶青柠腌鲷鱼。

words.note: 鱼没加热，是被酸“腌熟”的。南太平洋岛国也有类似的 ika mata。

words.zh: 意式生鱼片（淋橄榄油、柠檬）
words.definition: Thin slices of raw fish dressed with olive oil, citrus and salt.

examples.en: Tuna crudo with blood orange.
examples.zh: 金枪鱼生鱼片配血橙。

words.zh: 扇贝
words.definition: Shellfish with a round fan-shaped shell and a sweet, white, round muscle.

examples.en: Seared scallops with pea purée and bacon.
examples.zh: 香煎扇贝配豌豆泥和培根。

words.zh: 鱿鱼圈（裹粉炸的鱿鱼）
words.definition: Squid, usually cut into rings or strips and fried.

examples.en: A bowl of crumbed calamari with aioli.
examples.zh: 一份裹面包糠炸鱿鱼配蒜蓉蛋黄酱。

words.note: calamari 是意大利语“鱿鱼”，菜单上通常指炸鱿鱼；squid 是英文通称。

words.zh: 椒盐鱿鱼
words.definition: Squid coated in seasoned flour, fried and tossed with salt, pepper and chilli.

examples.en: We'll start with the salt and pepper squid.
examples.zh: 我们先来一份椒盐鱿鱼。

words.zh: 章鱼
words.definition: A sea animal with eight arms, cooked until tender and often grilled.

examples.en: Chargrilled octopus with chorizo and potatoes.
examples.zh: 炭烤章鱼配西班牙辣肠和土豆。

words.zh: 蛤蜊
words.definition: Small shellfish with two hard shells, cooked until they open.

examples.en: Clams steamed in white wine and garlic.
examples.zh: 白葡萄酒蒜香蒸蛤蜊。

words.zh: 新西兰小圆蛤（海瓜子类）
words.definition: Small round shellfish like little clams, common on New Zealand beaches.

examples.en: Linguine with local cockles and chilli.
examples.zh: 本地小圆蛤辣椒扁意面。

words.note: 新西兰的 cockle 毛利语叫 tuangi。

words.zh: 新西兰沙滩蛤（长椭圆形）
words.definition: A New Zealand surf clam with a smooth, oval shell.

examples.en: Tuatua fritters are a beach-town favourite.
examples.zh: 沙滩蛤饼是海边小镇的最爱。

words.zh: 生蚝
words.definition: Shellfish with a rough shell, often eaten raw with lemon.

examples.en: Half a dozen oysters, please.
examples.zh: 请来半打生蚝。

words.note: 新西兰南岛 Bluff oysters 很有名，季节大约是每年三月到八月。

words.zh: （生蚝）原味生吃
words.definition: Oysters served raw, with only lemon or a light dressing.

examples.en: Would you like the oysters natural or tempura?
examples.zh: 生蚝要原味生吃还是天妇罗炸的？

words.note: 菜单写 oysters natural 就是生的原味。

words.zh: 现开的（撬开壳的）
words.definition: With the shell opened just before serving.

examples.en: Our oysters are freshly shucked to order.
examples.zh: 我们的生蚝点单后现开。

words.zh: 带半边壳上桌的
words.definition: Served raw in one half of their shell.

examples.en: Oysters on the half shell with mignonette.
examples.zh: 半壳生蚝配红葱醋汁。

words.zh: 海螯虾（细长的小龙虾，肉甜）
words.definition: A small, pink lobster-like shellfish with sweet meat.

examples.en: Grilled New Zealand scampi with garlic butter.
examples.zh: 蒜香黄油烤新西兰海螯虾。

words.note: 英国的 scampi 常指裹面包糠的炸虾块；新西兰菜单多指整只海螯虾。

words.zh: 软壳蟹（整只可吃）
words.definition: A crab that has just shed its hard shell, so you can eat the whole thing.

examples.en: Tempura soft-shell crab bao.
examples.zh: 天妇罗软壳蟹包子。

words.zh: 新西兰鲍鱼（壳是彩虹色的）
words.definition: A New Zealand abalone, a sea snail with a rainbow-coloured shell.

examples.en: Paua fritters are a Kiwi classic.
examples.zh: 鲍鱼饼是新西兰经典。

words.zh: 鱼籽
words.definition: Fish eggs, eaten raw, salted or cured.

examples.en: Topped with salmon roe and dill.
examples.zh: 上面放三文鱼籽和莳萝。

words.zh: 鱼子酱（鲟鱼籽，昂贵）
words.definition: Salted eggs of the sturgeon fish, very expensive.

examples.en: The blini come with crème fraîche and caviar.
examples.zh: 俄式小煎饼配法式酸奶油和鱼子酱。

words.zh: 北欧腌三文鱼（盐糖莳萝腌，生吃）
words.definition: Raw salmon cured with salt, sugar and dill, then sliced thinly.

examples.en: House gravlax with pickled cucumber.
examples.zh: 自制腌三文鱼配腌黄瓜。

words.zh: 热熏三文鱼（熏熟的，呈块状）
words.definition: Salmon smoked with heat, so it is cooked and flakes into pieces.

examples.en: Hot-smoked salmon salad with potatoes and egg.
examples.zh: 热熏三文鱼沙拉配土豆和鸡蛋。

words.note: 普通 smoked salmon 是冷熏的，生的薄片；热熏是熟的。

words.zh: （鱼、肉的）去骨肉片/鱼排
words.definition: A piece of fish or meat with the bones taken out.

examples.en: Two fillets of fish with salad.
examples.zh: 两块鱼排配沙拉。

words.note: 英国/新西兰读 FIL-it，美国常读 fih-LAY。

words.zh: 带皮的
words.definition: Cooked with the skin left on.

examples.en: Skin-on salmon fillet with crispy skin.
examples.zh: 带皮三文鱼，鱼皮煎得很脆。

words.zh: 海鲜拼盘
words.definition: A large plate of mixed seafood to share.

examples.en: The seafood platter for two has oysters, prawns and crayfish.
examples.zh: 双人海鲜拼盘有生蚝、大虾和龙虾。

words.zh: 海鲜浓汤（奶油土豆汤底）
words.definition: A thick, creamy soup with seafood and potato.

examples.en: A bowl of seafood chowder with buttered bread.
examples.zh: 一碗海鲜浓汤配黄油面包。

words.zh: 浓虾汤/甲壳类浓汤
words.definition: A smooth, rich, creamy soup made from shellfish such as crayfish or prawns.

examples.en: Crayfish bisque with a dash of brandy.
examples.zh: 龙虾浓汤加一点白兰地。

words.zh: 鸡尾酒虾（冷虾配粉红酱，复古前菜）
words.definition: A cold starter of prawns with a pink, creamy sauce and lettuce.

examples.en: Prawn cocktail is back on the menu as a retro starter.
examples.zh: 复古前菜鸡尾酒虾又回到了菜单上。

words.zh: 奶酪拼盘
words.definition: A selection of cheeses served with crackers, fruit and chutney.

examples.en: Shall we share a cheese board instead of dessert?
examples.zh: 我们分一份奶酪拼盘代替甜点吧？

words.zh: 冷切肉拼盘（腌肉、火腿、肉酱等）
words.definition: Cured and prepared meats such as ham, salami and pâté, served on a board to share.

examples.en: The charcuterie board comes with pickles and bread.
examples.zh: 冷肉拼盘配腌菜和面包。

words.zh: 意式前菜拼盘（冷肉、奶酪、腌菜）
words.definition: An Italian starter plate of cured meats, cheese, olives and pickled vegetables.

examples.en: The antipasto platter is great for sharing.
examples.zh: 意式前菜拼盘很适合分享。

words.note: 复数 antipasti。

words.zh: 卡门贝尔奶酪（类似布里，味更浓）
words.definition: A soft, creamy French cheese with a white rind, stronger than brie.

examples.en: Whole baked camembert with crusty bread to dip.
examples.zh: 整个烤卡门贝尔奶酪配脆皮面包蘸着吃。

words.note: 法语 t 不发音。

words.zh: 古冈佐拉（意大利蓝纹奶酪）
words.definition: An Italian blue cheese, creamy and strong.

examples.en: Gnocchi in a gorgonzola cream sauce.
examples.zh: 古冈佐拉奶油酱土豆团子。

words.zh: 帕玛森奶酪（意大利硬奶酪，常刨片）
words.definition: A hard, salty Italian cheese, usually grated or shaved over food.

examples.en: Would you like some parmesan on your pasta?
examples.zh: 意面要撒点帕玛森奶酪吗？

words.note: 正宗原产地叫 Parmigiano Reggiano（par-mih-JAH-noh reh-JAH-noh）。

words.zh: 佩科里诺（意大利绵羊奶硬奶酪，更咸）
words.definition: A hard, salty Italian cheese made from sheep's milk.

examples.en: Cacio e pepe is made with pecorino and black pepper.
examples.zh: 黑胡椒奶酪面用佩科里诺奶酪和黑胡椒做。

words.zh: 马苏里拉（白色有弹性，烤后拉丝）
words.definition: A soft, white, mild Italian cheese that melts and stretches.

examples.en: Fresh mozzarella with tomato and basil.
examples.zh: 新鲜马苏里拉配番茄和罗勒。

words.zh: 水牛马苏里拉（用水牛奶做，更香滑）
words.definition: Mozzarella made from the milk of water buffalo, softer and richer than cow's milk mozzarella.

examples.en: Buffalo mozzarella with heirloom tomatoes.
examples.zh: 水牛马苏里拉配传统品种番茄。

words.zh: 布拉塔（外皮是马苏里拉，里面是奶油碎芝士）
words.definition: A ball of fresh mozzarella filled with soft cream and cheese.

examples.en: Burrata with peaches, prosciutto and basil.
examples.zh: 布拉塔奶酪配桃子、帕尔马火腿和罗勒。

words.zh: 斯特拉恰泰拉（奶油拌碎马苏里拉丝）
words.definition: Soft shreds of fresh cheese soaked in cream; also the filling of burrata.

examples.en: Stracciatella with grilled bread and olive oil.
examples.zh: 奶油碎芝士配烤面包和橄榄油。

words.note: 同名的冰淇淋是带巧克力碎的奶味冰淇淋。

words.zh: 山羊奶酪（白色，酸香）
words.definition: Cheese made from goat's milk, white and tangy.

examples.en: Beetroot and goat's cheese salad.
examples.zh: 甜菜根山羊奶酪沙拉。

words.note: 法语叫 chèvre（SHEV-ruh）。

words.zh: 意大利乳清奶酪（白色，松软微甜）
words.definition: A soft, white, slightly sweet fresh Italian cheese.

examples.en: Spinach and ricotta ravioli.
examples.zh: 菠菜乳清奶酪意式饺子。

words.zh: 马斯卡彭（非常浓滑的奶油奶酪）
words.definition: A very rich, smooth Italian cream cheese, used in tiramisu.

examples.en: Poached pears with vanilla mascarpone.
examples.zh: 煮梨配香草马斯卡彭。

words.zh: 格鲁耶尔（瑞士硬奶酪，坚果香，易融化）
words.definition: A hard Swiss cheese with a nutty taste that melts well.

examples.en: French onion soup topped with melted gruyère.
examples.zh: 法式洋葱汤上面盖着融化的格鲁耶尔奶酪。

words.zh: 切达奶酪（最常见的黄色奶酪）
words.definition: A firm, yellow or white cheese, mild to sharp in taste.

examples.en: Aged cheddar with apple and crackers.
examples.zh: 陈年切达配苹果和饼干。

words.note: 新西兰超市的 tasty cheese 就是味道较浓的切达。

words.zh: 曼切戈（西班牙绵羊奶酪）
words.definition: A firm Spanish cheese made from sheep's milk.

examples.en: Manchego with quince paste and almonds.
examples.zh: 曼切戈奶酪配榅桲膏和杏仁。

words.zh: 高达奶酪（荷兰奶酪，柔和）
words.definition: A mild, smooth Dutch cheese that becomes nutty when aged.

examples.en: Smoked gouda on the burger.
examples.zh: 汉堡里放烟熏高达奶酪。

words.zh: 洗浸奶酪（橙色外皮，气味浓烈）
words.definition: A soft cheese whose orange rind is washed in brine, giving it a strong smell.

examples.en: Our washed-rind cheese is quite pungent but very creamy.
examples.zh: 我们的洗浸奶酪气味较冲，但非常香滑。

words.zh: 陈年的（熟成时间长，味更浓）
words.definition: Kept for a long time to develop a stronger flavour.

examples.en: Twenty-four-month aged parmesan.
examples.zh: 二十四个月陈年帕玛森。

words.zh: 榅桲膏（配奶酪的果冻状甜膏）
words.definition: A firm, sweet jelly made from quince fruit, served with cheese.

examples.en: The cheese comes with quince paste and lavosh.
examples.zh: 奶酪配榅桲膏和亚美尼亚薄脆饼。

words.zh: 薄脆饼（配奶酪的长条脆饼）
words.definition: Thin, crisp crackers often served with cheese and dips in New Zealand.

examples.en: Can we get some more lavosh for the dips?
examples.zh: 能再给我们一些薄脆饼配蘸酱吗？

words.note: 原本是亚美尼亚的软薄饼；新西兰菜单上的 lavosh 多指烤脆的薄饼干。

words.zh: 意式培根（盐腌五花肉）
words.definition: Italian cured pork belly, like bacon but not smoked.

examples.en: Peas and pancetta with a poached egg.
examples.zh: 豌豆和意式培根配水波蛋。

words.zh: 意式风干猪颈肉
words.definition: Cured pork from the neck and shoulder, sliced very thin.

examples.en: The board has coppa, salami and prosciutto.
examples.zh: 拼盘里有风干猪颈肉、萨拉米和帕尔马火腿。

words.note: 也叫 capocollo。

words.zh: 风干牛肉薄片
words.definition: Air-dried salted beef, sliced very thin.

examples.en: Bresaola with rocket and parmesan.
examples.zh: 风干牛肉配芝麻菜和帕玛森。

words.zh: 意式大红肠（有白色脂肪粒，常带开心果）
words.definition: A large, smooth Italian pork sausage with small cubes of fat, served cold.

examples.en: A mortadella and pistachio sandwich.
examples.zh: 意式大红肠开心果三明治。

words.zh: 辣味可涂抹萨拉米（意大利南部）
words.definition: A soft, spicy, spreadable pork sausage from southern Italy.

examples.en: Pizza with 'nduja and honey.
examples.zh: 辣肉酱蜂蜜披萨。

words.zh: 肉酱/肝酱（抹面包吃）
words.definition: A smooth paste of cooked meat or liver, spread on bread or toast.

examples.en: Chicken liver pâté with toasted brioche.
examples.zh: 鸡肝酱配烤布里欧修。

words.zh: 鸡肝慕斯（非常细滑的鸡肝酱）
words.definition: A very smooth, light chicken liver pâté.

examples.en: Chicken liver parfait with onion jam and toast.
examples.zh: 鸡肝慕斯配洋葱果酱和吐司。

words.note: 这里的 parfait 是咸的，和甜点 parfait 不同。

words.zh: 冻肉批（压在长模里切片的肉/菜冷盘）
words.definition: Meat, fish or vegetables pressed into a loaf-shaped dish, chilled and sliced.

examples.en: Ham hock terrine with piccalilli.
examples.zh: 猪肘冻肉批配芥末腌菜。

words.zh: 熟肉酱（油封慢煮后撕碎）
words.definition: Meat such as pork or duck cooked slowly in fat, shredded and served as a spread.

examples.en: Duck rillettes with cornichons.
examples.zh: 鸭肉酱配小酸黄瓜。

words.zh: 法式小酸黄瓜
words.definition: Small, crunchy, sour French pickled cucumbers.

examples.en: Pâté is always served with cornichons.
examples.zh: 肉酱总是配小酸黄瓜。

words.zh: 卡拉马塔橄榄（希腊紫黑色橄榄）
words.definition: Dark purple Greek olives with a rich, fruity taste.

examples.en: Warm Kalamata olives with orange zest.
examples.zh: 温热卡拉马塔橄榄配橙皮。

words.note: 菜单常提醒 olives may contain pits（可能有核）。

words.zh: 佛卡夏（意式橄榄油扁面包）
words.definition: A flat, soft Italian bread with olive oil, salt and often rosemary.

examples.en: House focaccia with olive oil and dukkah.
examples.zh: 自制佛卡夏配橄榄油和杜卡香料。

words.zh: 恰巴塔（意式拖鞋面包，孔大皮脆）
words.definition: A long, flat Italian white bread with large holes and a crisp crust.

examples.en: The steak sandwich is on toasted ciabatta.
examples.zh: 牛排三明治用烤恰巴塔面包。

words.zh: 法棍
words.definition: A long, thin French loaf with a crisp crust.

examples.en: A warm baguette with the soup.
examples.zh: 汤配一根热法棍。

words.zh: 意式烤面包薄片（上面放配料）
words.definition: Small thin slices of toasted bread with toppings.

examples.en: Mushroom crostini to start.
examples.zh: 先来一份蘑菇烤面包片。

words.zh: 意式面包棍（细长脆条）
words.definition: Long, thin, crunchy Italian breadsticks.

examples.en: Grissini wrapped in prosciutto.
examples.zh: 火腿卷面包棍。

words.zh: 黑麦面包（颜色深，味酸）
words.definition: A dense, dark bread made with rye flour.

examples.en: Smoked fish on rye bread.
examples.zh: 黑麦面包配熏鱼。

words.zh: 发酵黄油（带微酸奶香）
words.definition: Butter made from cream that has been slightly fermented, giving a richer, tangier taste.

examples.en: The bread is served with house cultured butter.
examples.zh: 面包配自制发酵黄油。

words.zh: 焦糖布丁（表面一层脆焦糖的蛋奶冻）
words.definition: A rich, cold vanilla custard with a thin layer of hard burnt sugar on top.

examples.en: I love cracking the top of a crème brûlée.
examples.zh: 我喜欢敲开焦糖布丁表面那层脆糖。

words.note: 菜单常不写重音符号：creme brulee。

words.zh: 意式奶冻（奶油做的凝冻，滑嫩）
words.definition: A smooth, set Italian cream dessert, often served with fruit sauce.

examples.en: Vanilla panna cotta with passionfruit.
examples.zh: 香草意式奶冻配百香果。

words.note: 通常用吉利丁（动物胶）凝固，素食者需注意。

words.zh: 提拉米苏（咖啡酒浸手指饼+马斯卡彭）
words.definition: An Italian dessert of sponge fingers soaked in coffee, layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa.

examples.en: The tiramisu has a bit of alcohol in it.
examples.zh: 提拉米苏里面有一点酒。

words.zh: 熔岩巧克力蛋糕（中心是流心巧克力）
words.definition: A small baked chocolate cake with a soft, runny centre.

examples.en: The chocolate fondant takes 15 minutes, is that OK?
examples.zh: 熔岩巧克力蛋糕要15分钟，可以吗？

words.note: 美国常叫 molten lava cake。

words.zh: 半冻冰糕（介于慕斯和冰淇淋之间）
words.definition: A half-frozen Italian dessert like a soft, creamy ice cream cake.

examples.en: Honey and almond semifreddo.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜杏仁半冻冰糕。

words.zh: 挞（敞口酥皮馅饼）
words.definition: A pastry case with an open top, filled with fruit, custard or chocolate.

examples.en: Lemon tart with crème fraîche.
examples.zh: 柠檬挞配法式酸奶油。

words.zh: 反烤苹果挞（焦糖苹果在下，酥皮在上烤后倒扣）
words.definition: An upside-down tart of caramelised apples baked under pastry, then turned over.

examples.en: Tarte tatin for two with vanilla ice cream.
examples.zh: 双人份反烤苹果挞配香草冰淇淋。

words.zh: 舒芙蕾（蓬松的烤蛋白甜点，出炉要马上吃）
words.definition: A light, puffy baked dish made with whipped egg whites, served straight from the oven.

examples.en: The soufflé needs 20 minutes, so please order it now.
examples.zh: 舒芙蕾需要20分钟，请现在就点。

words.note: 也有咸的芝士舒芙蕾，例如 twice-baked cheese soufflé。

words.zh: 泡芙塔（小泡芙夹奶油淋巧克力）
words.definition: Small balls of light pastry filled with cream and covered in chocolate sauce.

examples.en: Profiteroles with warm chocolate sauce.
examples.zh: 泡芙配热巧克力酱。

words.zh: 慕斯（打发后很轻盈的奶油甜点）
words.definition: A light, airy dessert made with whipped cream or egg whites.

examples.en: Dark chocolate mousse with raspberries.
examples.zh: 黑巧克力慕斯配覆盆子。

words.zh: 冻糕/芭菲（法式是冰冻奶油冻）
words.definition: A frozen dessert made of cream, eggs and sugar; in the US, layers of fruit, yoghurt and granola in a glass.

examples.en: Passionfruit parfait with meringue.
examples.zh: 百香果冻糕配蛋白霜。

words.note: 法式 parfait 是切块的冰冻奶油；美式是杯装分层酸奶水果。

words.zh: 马卡龙（杏仁蛋白小圆饼夹馅）
words.definition: A small, colourful French biscuit made of almond meringue with a filling in the middle.

examples.en: Each coffee comes with a macaron.
examples.zh: 每杯咖啡送一个马卡龙。

words.note: macaroon（mak-uh-ROON）是椰丝做的另一种饼干，别混。

words.zh: 拿破仑（千层酥夹奶油）
words.definition: Layers of thin, crisp puff pastry with cream in between.

examples.en: Vanilla mille-feuille with berries.
examples.zh: 香草千层酥配莓果。

words.zh: 伊顿麦斯（碎蛋白霜、奶油和草莓拌在一起）
words.definition: A British dessert of broken meringue, whipped cream and strawberries mixed together.

examples.en: Eton mess is a light summer dessert.
examples.zh: 伊顿麦斯是清爽的夏日甜点。

words.zh: 面包黄油布丁（面包泡蛋奶烤的热甜点）
words.definition: A warm baked dessert of buttered bread soaked in custard, often with raisins.

examples.en: Brioche bread and butter pudding with whisky sauce.
examples.zh: 布里欧修面包黄油布丁配威士忌酱。

words.zh: 克拉芙缇（樱桃蛋奶烤饼）
words.definition: A French baked dessert of fruit, usually cherries, in a thick pancake-like batter.

examples.en: Cherry clafoutis, served warm.
examples.zh: 樱桃克拉芙缇，热的上桌。

words.zh: 英式蛋奶酱（稀的香草卡仕达酱）
words.definition: A thin, pourable vanilla custard sauce.

examples.en: Served with crème anglaise.
examples.zh: 配英式蛋奶酱。

words.zh: 香缇奶油（加糖和香草的打发奶油）
words.definition: Whipped cream sweetened with sugar and vanilla.

examples.en: Strawberries with Chantilly cream.
examples.zh: 草莓配香缇奶油。

words.zh: 蛋白霜（蛋白加糖打发后烤干，酥脆）
words.definition: Egg whites and sugar whipped and baked until crisp and light.

examples.en: Lemon tart topped with toasted meringue.
examples.zh: 柠檬挞上面放着炙烤过的蛋白霜。

words.zh: 蜂巢糖（金黄色脆糖块）
words.definition: A crunchy, golden toffee full of air bubbles.

examples.en: Vanilla ice cream with honeycomb pieces.
examples.zh: 香草冰淇淋配蜂巢糖碎。

words.note: 新西兰的 hokey pokey 冰淇淋里就是这种糖。

words.zh: 海盐焦糖
words.definition: Caramel with a little salt added to balance the sweetness.

examples.en: Salted caramel tart with crème fraîche.
examples.zh: 海盐焦糖挞配法式酸奶油。

words.zh: 甘纳许（巧克力和奶油混合的浓滑酱）
words.definition: A smooth, rich mixture of melted chocolate and cream.

examples.en: A chocolate tart with a dark ganache filling.
examples.zh: 黑巧克力甘纳许馅的巧克力挞。

words.zh: 果仁糖（焦糖坚果，常压碎撒上）
words.definition: Nuts cooked in caramel, often crushed and sprinkled on desserts.

examples.en: Hazelnut praline on top of the mousse.
examples.zh: 慕斯上撒着榛子果仁糖。

words.zh: 糖煮水果
words.definition: Fruit cooked slowly in sugar syrup.

examples.en: Yoghurt panna cotta with rhubarb compote.
examples.zh: 酸奶奶冻配糖煮大黄。

words.zh: 柠檬奶冻（奶油加柠檬汁凝固）
words.definition: A smooth, set cream dessert made with lemon juice and sugar.

examples.en: Lemon posset with shortbread.
examples.zh: 柠檬奶冻配黄油酥饼。

words.zh: 沙巴雍（蛋黄、糖、甜酒打发的蛋奶酱）
words.definition: A light, foamy Italian custard of egg yolks, sugar and sweet wine.

examples.en: Fresh berries with warm zabaglione.
examples.zh: 新鲜莓果配温热沙巴雍。

words.note: 法语叫 sabayon（sa-ba-YON）。

words.zh: 黑森林蛋糕（巧克力、樱桃、奶油）
words.definition: A chocolate layer cake with cherries and whipped cream.

examples.en: A retro Black Forest gâteau for dessert.
examples.zh: 甜点来一块复古黑森林蛋糕。

words.note: gâteau 是法语“蛋糕”，菜单上指多层奶油蛋糕。

words.zh: 奶酪卷（西西里炸脆管填乳清奶酪）
words.definition: Sicilian crisp fried pastry tubes filled with sweet ricotta cream.

examples.en: Pistachio cannoli to finish.
examples.zh: 最后来个开心果奶酪卷。

words.zh: 精致小点心（餐后配咖啡的一口甜点）
words.definition: Very small cakes, chocolates or sweets served with coffee at the end of a meal.

examples.en: Coffee and petit fours are included in the set menu.
examples.zh: 套餐包含咖啡和餐后小点心。

words.zh: 酒单
words.definition: The menu of wines a restaurant sells, with prices by the glass and bottle.

examples.en: Could we see the wine list, please?
examples.zh: 能给我们看一下酒单吗？

words.zh: 按杯（卖）
words.definition: Sold as a single glass rather than a whole bottle.

examples.en: Which wines do you have by the glass?
examples.zh: 你们有哪些酒可以按杯点？

words.note: by the bottle 按瓶。

words.zh: 一杯红酒
words.definition: A short way to order one glass of red wine.

examples.en: I'll have a glass of red — the pinot, please.
examples.zh: 我要一杯红酒，黑皮诺，谢谢。

words.note: 同理 a glass of white（白葡萄酒）。

words.zh: 餐厅自选酒（最便宜的招牌酒）
words.definition: The restaurant's own standard choice of wine, usually the cheapest on the list.

examples.en: The house white is a Marlborough sauvignon blanc.
examples.zh: 店里的招牌白葡萄酒是马尔堡长相思。

words.zh: 玻璃酒壶（约半瓶或一瓶的量）
words.definition: A glass jug for serving wine or water at the table.

examples.en: Could we get a carafe of the house red?
examples.zh: 能来一壶招牌红酒吗？

words.zh: 长相思（新西兰最出名的白葡萄酒）
words.definition: A fresh, crisp white wine with tropical and grassy flavours; New Zealand's most famous wine.

examples.en: A glass of the Marlborough sauvignon blanc, please.
examples.zh: 请来一杯马尔堡长相思。

words.note: 口语常简称 savvy 或 sav。马尔堡（Marlborough）是主产区。

words.zh: 黑皮诺（轻盈红酒，新西兰中奥塔哥出名）
words.definition: A light, smooth red wine with red-fruit flavours.

examples.en: Central Otago pinot noir goes well with duck.
examples.zh: 中奥塔哥黑皮诺很配鸭肉。

words.note: t 和 r 的拼写都不按字面读。

words.zh: 霞多丽（白葡萄酒，可清爽或带橡木奶油味）
words.definition: A white wine that can be fresh and fruity or rich and buttery.

examples.en: I prefer an unoaked chardonnay.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢没过橡木桶的霞多丽。

words.note: 新西兰的霍克斯湾（Hawke's Bay）和吉斯伯恩（Gisborne）都产。

words.zh: 灰皮诺（柔和带果香的白葡萄酒）
words.definition: A soft, fruity white wine, sometimes slightly sweet.

examples.en: The pinot gris is a nice match for Thai food.
examples.zh: 灰皮诺很配泰国菜。

words.note: 意大利风格叫 pinot grigio（GREE-joh），同一个葡萄品种。

words.zh: 雷司令（白葡萄酒，从干到甜都有）
words.definition: A fragrant white wine with high acidity, from dry to sweet.

examples.en: Is the riesling dry or off-dry?
examples.zh: 这款雷司令是干型还是半干？

words.zh: 琼瑶浆（香气浓郁的白葡萄酒，荔枝玫瑰香）
words.definition: A very fragrant white wine with flavours like lychee and rose.

examples.en: Gewürztraminer is great with spicy food.
examples.zh: 琼瑶浆很配辣菜。

words.zh: 桃红葡萄酒（粉红色）
words.definition: A pink wine, usually dry and fresh, served cold.

examples.en: A bottle of rosé for the table on a sunny afternoon.
examples.zh: 阳光明媚的下午来一瓶桃红给大家。

words.zh: 梅洛（柔顺的红酒）
words.definition: A soft, smooth red wine with plum flavours.

examples.en: The merlot blend from Hawke's Bay is very smooth.
examples.zh: 霍克斯湾的梅洛混酿非常顺口。

words.note: t 不发音。

words.zh: 西拉（偏辛辣的红酒）
words.definition: A red wine with dark fruit and pepper flavours.

examples.en: Try the Hawke's Bay syrah with the lamb.
examples.zh: 羊肉试试霍克斯湾的西拉。

words.note: 同一个葡萄，澳洲叫 shiraz（shih-RAZ），通常风格更浓重。

words.zh: 赤霞珠（浓郁厚重的红酒）
words.definition: A strong, full-bodied red wine with blackcurrant flavours and firm tannins.

examples.en: A cabernet sauvignon would go well with the steak.
examples.zh: 赤霞珠配牛排会很好。

words.note: 口语简称 cab sav。

words.zh: 马尔贝克（阿根廷著名红酒，果味浓）
words.definition: A dark, juicy red wine, famous in Argentina.

examples.en: Malbec and steak are a classic match.
examples.zh: 马尔贝克配牛排是经典组合。

words.zh: 起泡酒（口语）
words.definition: An informal word for sparkling wine.

examples.en: Shall we start with a glass of bubbles?
examples.zh: 我们先来一杯起泡酒吧？

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲口语很常用。

words.zh: 起泡酒
words.definition: Wine with bubbles in it.

examples.en: Do you have a sparkling wine by the glass?
examples.zh: 有按杯的起泡酒吗？

words.zh: 普罗赛克（意大利起泡酒，果味清爽）
words.definition: A light, fruity Italian sparkling wine.

examples.en: A glass of prosecco to celebrate, please.
examples.zh: 请来一杯普罗赛克庆祝一下。

words.zh: 香槟（只指法国香槟区的起泡酒）
words.definition: Sparkling wine from the Champagne region of France.

examples.en: We're celebrating — a bottle of champagne, please.
examples.zh: 我们在庆祝，请来一瓶香槟。

words.note: 严格说只有法国香槟区出产的才叫 champagne。

words.zh: 传统法起泡酒（新西兰用香槟同工艺做的起泡酒）
words.definition: Sparkling wine made the same way as champagne, but not from the Champagne region.

examples.en: This Marlborough méthode traditionnelle is great value.
examples.zh: 这款马尔堡传统法起泡酒很划算。

words.note: 新西兰酒单常用此词，因为不能叫 champagne。

words.zh: 干型的（不甜）
words.definition: Describes wine that is not sweet.

examples.en: I'd like something dry and crisp.
examples.zh: 我想要干型、清爽的。

words.note: dry 说的是不甜，不是“干涩”。

words.zh: 甜型的
words.definition: Describes wine with a noticeable sugary taste.

examples.en: Is this riesling sweet?
examples.zh: 这款雷司令甜吗？

words.note: 半甜叫 off-dry 或 medium。

words.zh: 清爽的（酸度高、口感利落）
words.definition: Describes white wine that is fresh and refreshing, with good acidity.

examples.en: A crisp white would be perfect with oysters.
examples.zh: 清爽的白葡萄酒配生蚝最好。

words.zh: 酒体饱满的（浓郁、厚重）
words.definition: Describes wine that feels rich, heavy and strong in the mouth.

examples.en: I'm after a full-bodied red to go with the lamb.
examples.zh: 我想要一款酒体饱满的红酒配羊肉。

words.note: 反义 light-bodied（轻盈），中间 medium-bodied。

words.zh: 酒体轻盈的
words.definition: Describes wine that feels light and delicate in the mouth.

examples.en: Pinot noir is usually light-bodied.
examples.zh: 黑皮诺通常酒体轻盈。

words.zh: 过橡木桶的（带香草、烤面包味）
words.definition: Aged in oak barrels, which adds vanilla, toast and butter flavours.

examples.en: Do you prefer an oaked or unoaked chardonnay?
examples.zh: 你喜欢过桶的还是没过桶的霞多丽？

words.note: unoaked 没过桶，更清新。

words.zh: 单宁（红酒里让嘴发干发涩的成分）
words.definition: Substances in red wine that make your mouth feel dry.

examples.en: This cab sav has quite firm tannins.
examples.zh: 这款赤霞珠单宁挺重的。

words.zh: 年份（葡萄采收年份）
words.definition: The year the grapes were picked and the wine was made.

examples.en: Which vintage is the pinot?
examples.zh: 这款黑皮诺是哪一年的？

words.zh: （酒）被木塞污染的（有霉味）
words.definition: Describes wine spoiled by a bad cork, smelling musty like wet cardboard.

examples.en: I think this bottle is corked — it smells musty.
examples.zh: 我觉得这瓶酒被木塞污染了，有霉味。

words.note: 酒被污染可以要求换一瓶；不喜欢口味不算 corked。

words.zh: 配酒（每道菜配一杯合适的酒）
words.definition: Wines chosen to match each dish, often offered with a tasting menu.

examples.en: The tasting menu is $150, plus $90 for the wine pairing.
examples.zh: 品鉴菜单150元，配酒另加90元。

words.note: 新西兰菜单也写 matched wines。

words.zh: 侍酒师
words.definition: A restaurant's wine expert, who helps you choose wine.

examples.en: Let's ask the sommelier what goes with the venison.
examples.zh: 问问侍酒师配鹿肉喝什么吧。

words.note: 口语简称 somm。

words.zh: 醒酒（倒入醒酒器）
words.definition: To pour wine into another container so it can breathe or leave its sediment behind.

examples.en: Would you like me to decant the wine?
examples.zh: 需要我帮您醒酒吗？

words.zh: 开胃酒（餐前喝的酒）
words.definition: A drink before a meal to stimulate the appetite.

examples.en: Would you like an aperitif while you look at the menu?
examples.zh: 您看菜单的时候要来杯开胃酒吗？

words.zh: 餐后酒（帮助消化的烈酒）
words.definition: A strong drink after a meal, such as brandy or grappa.

examples.en: Can I offer you a digestif?
examples.zh: 要来一杯餐后酒吗？

words.zh: 波特酒（葡萄牙甜红加强酒）
words.definition: A strong, sweet red wine from Portugal, usually drunk after dinner.

examples.en: A glass of port with the cheese board.
examples.zh: 奶酪拼盘配一杯波特酒。

words.zh: 甜酒（配甜点的甜白葡萄酒）
words.definition: A very sweet wine served in a small glass with dessert.

examples.en: A late-harvest riesling as a dessert wine.
examples.zh: 用晚收雷司令作甜酒。

words.zh: 雪莉酒（西班牙加强型葡萄酒）
words.definition: A Spanish fortified wine, from very dry to very sweet.

examples.en: A glass of dry sherry with the tapas.
examples.zh: 西班牙小吃配一杯干型雪莉酒。

words.zh: 柠檬甜酒（意大利柠檬利口酒）
words.definition: A sweet Italian lemon liqueur, served ice cold after dinner.

examples.en: The owner brought us limoncello on the house.
examples.zh: 老板免费请我们喝柠檬甜酒。

words.zh: 内格罗尼（金酒、金巴利、甜苦艾酒）
words.definition: A bitter, strong cocktail of gin, Campari and sweet vermouth.

examples.en: I'll start with a negroni.
examples.zh: 我先来一杯内格罗尼。

words.zh: 斯普瑞兹（起泡酒加苦橙利口酒和苏打水）
words.definition: A light cocktail of sparkling wine, a bitter liqueur such as Aperol, and soda water.

examples.en: Two Aperol spritzes, please.
examples.zh: 请来两杯阿佩罗斯普瑞兹。

words.zh: 添酒/续杯
words.definition: More drink poured into your glass before it is empty.

examples.en: Can I give you a top-up?
examples.zh: 给您添点酒吗？

words.zh: 品鉴套餐（多道小份菜的主厨菜单）
words.definition: A meal of many small courses chosen by the chef, so you can taste a range of dishes.

examples.en: We booked the seven-course degustation for our anniversary.
examples.zh: 我们周年纪念订了七道菜的品鉴套餐。

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲常用 degustation；美国多说 tasting menu。

words.zh: 品鉴菜单
words.definition: A fixed set of many small dishes chosen by the chef.

examples.en: The tasting menu must be ordered by the whole table.
examples.zh: 品鉴菜单需要全桌一起点。

words.zh: 套餐（固定菜单）
words.definition: A fixed menu with a set number of courses at one price.

examples.en: On Friday nights there's only a set menu.
examples.zh: 周五晚上只有套餐。

words.zh: 固定价格套餐
words.definition: A meal with several courses for one fixed price.

examples.en: The prix fixe lunch is two courses for $45.
examples.zh: 固定价格午餐两道菜45元。

words.note: 法语“固定价格”。

words.zh: （一）道菜
words.definition: One part of a meal, such as the starter, main or dessert.

examples.en: The next course is the lamb.
examples.zh: 下一道菜是羊肉。

words.note: three-course meal = 三道菜（前菜、主菜、甜点）。

words.zh: 开胃小点（主厨免费送的一口小菜）
words.definition: A tiny free bite from the chef, served before the first course.

examples.en: To start, an amuse-bouche from the chef.
examples.zh: 开始前，这是主厨送的开胃小点。

words.zh: 一口小点心（酒会上的小吃）
words.definition: A small bite of food on bread or pastry, served with drinks.

examples.en: Canapés will be served with drinks at seven.
examples.zh: 七点会随酒水上小点心。

words.zh: 开胃小吃（餐前小食）
words.definition: Small savoury foods served before a meal.

examples.en: They served hors d'oeuvres before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前他们上了开胃小吃。

words.zh: 清口小食（两道菜之间清口，多为雪葩）
words.definition: Something light, often a small sorbet, served between courses to refresh your mouth.

examples.en: A lemon sorbet as a palate cleanser before the main.
examples.zh: 主菜前上一份柠檬雪葩清口。

words.zh: 甜点前小甜品
words.definition: A small light sweet served before the main dessert.

examples.en: The pre-dessert was a tiny yoghurt mousse.
examples.zh: 甜点前小甜品是一小份酸奶慕斯。

words.zh: 主厨精选
words.definition: Dishes chosen by the chef, often whatever is best that day.

examples.en: Chef's selection of three cheeses.
examples.zh: 主厨精选三款奶酪。

words.zh: 宴席套餐（多人共享的固定菜单）
words.definition: A set menu of shared dishes for a group, often with a per-person price.

examples.en: For groups of eight or more, we offer a banquet at $75 per person.
examples.zh: 八人及以上我们提供每人75元的宴席套餐。

words.zh: 加价（某道菜额外收费）
words.definition: An extra charge for a more expensive dish on a set menu.

examples.en: Wagyu is available with a $20 supplement.
examples.zh: 换和牛需加20元。

words.zh: 饮食要求（过敏、忌口）
words.definition: Food you cannot or do not eat, such as allergies or a vegetarian diet.

examples.en: Does anyone at the table have any dietary requirements?
examples.zh: 这桌有人有饮食要求吗？

words.note: 订位时常问；可以回答 I'm allergic to shellfish 或 I don't eat pork。

words.zh: （某一轮）用餐时段
words.definition: One of the set times a restaurant seats customers.

examples.en: We have two seatings: 6 pm and 8:30 pm.
examples.zh: 我们有两个时段：六点和八点半。

words.zh: 主厨餐桌（靠近厨房的特别座位）
words.definition: A special table near or in the kitchen where the chef serves you directly.

examples.en: We sat at the chef's table and watched them plate up.
examples.zh: 我们坐在主厨餐桌，看他们摆盘。

words.zh: 餐厅领班（负责接待和安排座位）
words.definition: The head waiter who greets guests and manages the dining room.

examples.en: The maître d' showed us to our table.
examples.zh: 领班带我们到座位。

words.note: 完整写法 maître d'hôtel。

words.zh: 着装要求
words.definition: Rules about what clothes guests should wear.

examples.en: Is there a dress code, or is smart casual fine?
examples.zh: 有着装要求吗？还是半正式就可以？

words.zh: 半正式着装
words.definition: Neat but relaxed clothes, such as a shirt and chinos, not a suit.

examples.en: Dress code is smart casual — no jandals or singlets.
examples.zh: 着装要求半正式，不能穿人字拖和背心。

words.zh: 主厨赠送的
words.definition: Given free by the chef.

examples.en: This is compliments of the chef.
examples.zh: 这是主厨赠送的。

words.note: 也说 on the house（店家请客）。

words.zh: 您还在吃吗？（服务员问能否收盘）
words.definition: What a waiter asks to check if you have finished your plate.

examples.en: Are you still working on that? — Yes, still going, thanks.
examples.zh: 您还在吃吗？——还在吃，谢谢。

words.note: 吃完了可以说 All done, thanks。

words.zh: 泡沫（高级餐厅装饰用的轻盈泡沫酱）
words.definition: A light, airy froth made from a flavoured liquid, used to decorate a dish.

examples.en: Scallop with a smoked butter foam.
examples.zh: 扇贝配烟熏黄油泡沫。

words.zh: （摆盘用）可食用碎屑（像泥土）
words.definition: Dry crumbs made to look like earth, used for texture on modern plates.

examples.en: Chocolate mousse with cocoa soil.
examples.zh: 巧克力慕斯配可可碎屑。

words.note: 是酥脆的碎屑，不是真的泥土。

words.zh: 获“帽子”评级的（新西兰/澳洲美食奖）
words.definition: Awarded one or more 'hats' by a restaurant guide such as New Zealand's Cuisine Good Food Awards.

examples.en: It's a two-hatted restaurant, so book early.
examples.zh: 那是一家两顶帽子的餐厅，早点订位。

words.note: 新西兰没有米其林指南，高端餐厅用 hats 评级。

words.zh: 米其林星级
words.definition: An award from the Michelin Guide for excellent restaurants, from one to three stars.

examples.en: The chef used to work at a Michelin-starred restaurant in London.
examples.zh: 这位主厨以前在伦敦一家米其林星级餐厅工作。

words.zh: 洗手碗（吃手抓海鲜时洗手指用）
words.definition: A small bowl of water, often with lemon, for rinsing your fingers at the table.

examples.en: The crayfish comes with a finger bowl.
examples.zh: 龙虾配一个洗手碗。

words.note: 不是喝的汤或柠檬水。

words.zh: （面）有嚼劲的（煮到中心略硬）
words.definition: Cooked so that pasta is still slightly firm when you bite it.

examples.en: Our pasta is cooked al dente.
examples.zh: 我们的意面煮得有嚼劲。

words.note: 意大利语“对牙齿”。想要软一点可以说 Could you cook it a bit softer?

words.zh: 第一道主食（意面、烩饭）
words.definition: On an Italian menu, the first main section, usually pasta or risotto.

examples.en: Shall we share a primi before our mains?
examples.zh: 主菜前我们分一份意面吧？

words.note: 意式菜单顺序：antipasti 前菜 → primi 意面/烩饭 → secondi 肉鱼主菜 → dolci 甜点。

words.zh: 第二道主菜（肉或鱼）
words.definition: On an Italian menu, the meat or fish main courses.

examples.en: The secondi come with a side of greens.
examples.zh: 肉鱼主菜配一份青菜。

words.zh: 甜点（意大利菜单）
words.definition: On an Italian menu, the desserts.

examples.en: Let's look at the dolci.
examples.zh: 我们看看甜点吧。

words.zh: 意大利细长面
words.definition: Long, thin, round pasta.

examples.en: Spaghetti with meatballs for the kids.
examples.zh: 给孩子来份肉丸意面。

words.zh: 扁意面（细扁长面，常配海鲜）
words.definition: Long, flat, narrow pasta, often served with seafood.

examples.en: Linguine with prawns, chilli and garlic.
examples.zh: 辣椒蒜香大虾扁意面。

words.zh: 笔尖面（斜切短管面）
words.definition: Short tubes of pasta cut at an angle.

examples.en: Penne with tomato and chilli.
examples.zh: 番茄辣椒笔尖面。

words.zh: 粗管面（带条纹的大短管）
words.definition: Large, short pasta tubes with ridges, good with thick sauces.

examples.en: Rigatoni with slow-cooked beef ragù.
examples.zh: 粗管面配慢炖牛肉酱。

words.zh: 宽面（扁平长带状）
words.definition: Long, flat ribbons of pasta, often with creamy sauces.

examples.en: Fettuccine with mushrooms and cream.
examples.zh: 奶油蘑菇宽面。

words.zh: 宽带面（鸡蛋面，比宽面略窄）
words.definition: Long, flat egg pasta ribbons, often served with ragù.

examples.en: Fresh tagliatelle with bolognese.
examples.zh: 新鲜宽带面配肉酱。

words.zh: 特宽面（很宽的鸡蛋面带）
words.definition: Very wide, flat ribbons of egg pasta, often with rich meat sauces.

examples.en: Pappardelle with slow-braised duck ragù.
examples.zh: 慢炖鸭肉酱特宽面。

words.zh: 空心粗面（中间有细孔的长面）
words.definition: Thick spaghetti with a small hole running through the middle.

examples.en: Bucatini all'amatriciana.
examples.zh: 番茄培根空心粗面。

words.zh: 猫耳朵面（小耳朵形）
words.definition: Small pasta shaped like little ears.

examples.en: Orecchiette with sausage and broccoli.
examples.zh: 香肠西兰花猫耳朵面。

words.zh: 米粒面（形状像大米的意面）
words.definition: Small pasta shaped like grains of rice.

examples.en: Orzo salad with feta and herbs.
examples.zh: 米粒面沙拉配菲达和香草。

words.note: 看起来像米，但是是面粉做的，不是无麸质。

words.zh: 意式土豆团子（土豆和面粉做的小面团）
words.definition: Small soft dumplings made from potato and flour.

examples.en: Potato gnocchi with brown butter and sage.
examples.zh: 土豆团子配焦香黄油和鼠尾草。

words.note: g 不发音。

words.zh: 意式方饺（填馅的方形意面）
words.definition: Square pasta parcels with a filling such as cheese or meat.

examples.en: Pumpkin and ricotta ravioli.
examples.zh: 南瓜乳清奶酪方饺。

words.zh: 意式小馄饨（环形填馅意面）
words.definition: Small ring-shaped pasta with a filling.

examples.en: Tortellini in chicken broth.
examples.zh: 鸡汤意式小馄饨。

words.zh: 千层面
words.definition: Layers of flat pasta, meat sauce and white sauce, baked with cheese.

examples.en: The beef lasagne comes with a green salad.
examples.zh: 牛肉千层面配一份蔬菜沙拉。

words.note: 新西兰/英国拼 lasagne，美国拼 lasagna。

words.zh: 卡邦尼意面（培根、蛋黄、芝士做的白汁意面）
words.definition: Pasta with a sauce of egg yolk, cheese, cured pork and black pepper.

examples.en: Is the carbonara made with cream?
examples.zh: 卡邦尼里有放奶油吗？

words.note: 正宗做法不放奶油，用蛋黄增稠；很多新西兰餐厅会加奶油。

words.zh: 肉酱意面（番茄牛肉碎酱）
words.definition: A thick sauce of minced meat and tomato, usually served on pasta.

examples.en: Spaghetti bolognese is a family favourite.
examples.zh: 肉酱意面是全家的最爱。

words.note: 口语简称 spag bol。

words.zh: 意式慢炖肉酱
words.definition: A rich Italian meat sauce cooked slowly for hours.

examples.en: Pork and fennel ragù with pappardelle.
examples.zh: 猪肉茴香慢炖酱特宽面。

words.zh: 香辣番茄酱（蒜、辣椒）
words.definition: A spicy tomato sauce with garlic and dried chilli.

examples.en: Penne arrabbiata, but not too spicy please.
examples.zh: 香辣番茄笔尖面，请不要太辣。

words.note: 意大利语“生气的”，指辣。

words.zh: 蒜香橄榄油意面（蒜、油、辣椒）
words.definition: Simple pasta with garlic, olive oil and chilli.

examples.en: Spaghetti aglio e olio is simple but delicious.
examples.zh: 蒜香橄榄油意面简单但好吃。

words.zh: 黑胡椒奶酪意面（罗马名菜）
words.definition: A Roman pasta with pecorino cheese and lots of black pepper.

examples.en: The cacio e pepe is creamy but has no cream.
examples.zh: 黑胡椒奶酪面很浓滑，但没有奶油。

words.zh: 蛤蜊意面（白酒蒜香蛤蜊）
words.definition: Pasta, usually spaghetti, with clams, garlic, white wine and parsley.

examples.en: Spaghetti alle vongole with local clams.
examples.zh: 本地蛤蜊意面。

words.zh: 烟花女意面（番茄、橄榄、刺山柑、鳀鱼）
words.definition: A tomato sauce with olives, capers, anchovies and chilli.

examples.en: Puttanesca is salty and full of flavour.
examples.zh: 烟花女意面咸香浓郁。

words.zh: 番茄猪脸肉意面（罗马风味）
words.definition: A Roman tomato sauce with cured pork cheek, pecorino and chilli.

examples.en: Rigatoni amatriciana with guanciale.
examples.zh: 番茄猪脸肉粗管面。

words.zh: （新西兰常指）海鲜意面/（美国）番茄酱
words.definition: In New Zealand and Australia, often pasta with mixed seafood; in the US, a simple tomato sauce.

examples.en: The marinara has prawns, mussels and squid.
examples.zh: 海鲜意面里有虾、青口和鱿鱼。

words.note: 陷阱：新西兰/澳洲菜单上 marinara 常指海鲜（seafood marinara）；美国/意大利指无肉番茄酱。不确定就问。

words.zh: 春蔬意面（多种时令蔬菜）
words.definition: Pasta with lots of fresh spring vegetables.

examples.en: A vegetarian pasta primavera.
examples.zh: 素食春蔬意面。

words.zh: 意式烩饭（奶油般浓稠的米饭）
words.definition: Italian rice cooked slowly in stock until creamy.

examples.en: Mushroom risotto with truffle oil.
examples.zh: 松露油蘑菇烩饭。

words.note: 现点现做，通常要20分钟左右。

words.zh: 牛肝菌（意大利香菇，常用干的）
words.definition: A rich, meaty wild mushroom, often used dried.

examples.en: Porcini and thyme risotto.
examples.zh: 牛肝菌百里香烩饭。

words.zh: 意式烤面包（上放番茄罗勒）
words.definition: Toasted bread rubbed with garlic and topped with tomato, basil and olive oil.

examples.en: Tomato bruschetta to start.
examples.zh: 先来一份番茄烤面包。

words.note: 意大利语 sch 读 sk，不读“sh”。

words.zh: 卡布里沙拉（番茄、马苏里拉、罗勒）
words.definition: A salad of tomato, mozzarella and basil with olive oil.

examples.en: Caprese salad with buffalo mozzarella.
examples.zh: 水牛马苏里拉卡布里沙拉。

words.zh: 意式炸饭团（里面有芝士）
words.definition: Fried balls of risotto rice, coated in breadcrumbs, often with cheese inside.

examples.en: Mushroom arancini with aioli.
examples.zh: 蘑菇炸饭团配蒜蓉蛋黄酱。

words.zh: 意式包馅披萨（对折的披萨）
words.definition: A pizza folded in half like a big pocket, with the filling inside.

examples.en: The calzone is stuffed with ham and mozzarella.
examples.zh: 这个包馅披萨里有火腿和马苏里拉。

words.zh: 意式蔬菜汤
words.definition: A thick Italian vegetable soup, often with pasta or beans.

examples.en: A bowl of minestrone with crusty bread.
examples.zh: 一碗意式蔬菜汤配脆皮面包。

words.zh: 意式红烩牛膝（带骨髓的小牛腿肉）
words.definition: Veal shanks braised slowly with wine and vegetables, with marrow in the bone.

examples.en: Osso buco with saffron risotto.
examples.zh: 红烩牛膝配藏红花烩饭。

words.zh: 鼠尾草火腿小牛肉片
words.definition: Thin veal or chicken topped with prosciutto and sage, pan-fried in butter and wine.

examples.en: Chicken saltimbocca with lemon.
examples.zh: 鸡肉火腿鼠尾草卷配柠檬。

words.zh: 生牛肉薄片（冷盘）
words.definition: Very thin slices of raw beef or fish, dressed with oil, lemon and parmesan.

examples.en: Beef carpaccio with rocket and parmesan.
examples.zh: 生牛肉薄片配芝麻菜和帕玛森。

words.note: 是生的。

words.zh: 金枪鱼酱冷小牛肉
words.definition: Cold sliced veal served with a creamy tuna sauce.

examples.en: Vitello tonnato is a classic summer starter.
examples.zh: 金枪鱼酱冷小牛肉是夏季经典前菜。

words.zh: 焗茄子（茄子、番茄、芝士层层焗）
words.definition: Layers of fried eggplant, tomato sauce and cheese, baked.

examples.en: The eggplant parmigiana is our vegetarian main.
examples.zh: 焗茄子是我们的素食主菜。

words.note: 意大利名 melanzane alla parmigiana。

words.zh: 意式烤猪肉卷（香草卷起来的脆皮烤猪肉）
words.definition: A boneless pork roll stuffed with herbs and roasted with crispy skin.

examples.en: Porchetta roll with salsa verde.
examples.zh: 意式烤猪肉卷配青酱。

words.zh: 意式炸海鲜拼（混合裹粉炸）
words.definition: A mix of lightly fried seafood and vegetables.

examples.en: Fritto misto with lemon and aioli.
examples.zh: 意式炸海鲜配柠檬和蒜蓉蛋黄酱。

words.zh: 意式肉丸
words.definition: Italian meatballs, usually in tomato sauce.

examples.en: Polpette with whipped ricotta.
examples.zh: 意式肉丸配打发乳清奶酪。

words.zh: 意式切片牛排（铺芝麻菜）
words.definition: Grilled steak sliced thinly, usually on rocket with parmesan.

examples.en: Beef tagliata with rocket and balsamic.
examples.zh: 意式切片牛排配芝麻菜和黑醋。

words.zh: 炒面包屑（穷人的芝士，撒在意面上）
words.definition: Toasted breadcrumbs with garlic and herbs, sprinkled on pasta for crunch.

examples.en: Finished with chilli pangrattato.
examples.zh: 最后撒上辣椒炒面包屑。

words.zh: 寿司
words.definition: Small portions of vinegared rice with raw fish, seafood or vegetables.

examples.en: A sushi platter for two, please.
examples.zh: 请来一份双人寿司拼盘。

words.zh: 刺身（生鱼片，不带饭）
words.definition: Slices of raw fish or seafood served without rice.

examples.en: Salmon and tuna sashimi, five pieces each.
examples.zh: 三文鱼和金枪鱼刺身，各五片。

words.zh: 握寿司（饭团上放一片鱼）
words.definition: A hand-pressed oval of rice topped with a slice of fish.

examples.en: Two pieces of salmon nigiri.
examples.zh: 两个三文鱼握寿司。

words.zh: 卷寿司（海苔卷切段）
words.definition: Sushi rolled in seaweed and cut into round pieces.

examples.en: A tuna maki roll, cut into six.
examples.zh: 一条金枪鱼卷，切六段。

words.zh: 手卷（海苔卷成的圆锥形寿司）
words.definition: Sushi rolled by hand into a cone of seaweed, eaten with your fingers.

examples.en: Eat the hand roll quickly before the nori goes soft.
examples.zh: 手卷要趁海苔还脆的时候赶快吃。

words.note: 日语 temaki（teh-MAH-kee）。

words.zh: 反卷寿司（米饭在外，海苔在内）
words.definition: A sushi roll with the rice on the outside and the seaweed inside, like a California roll.

examples.en: Most rolls in New Zealand sushi shops are inside-out rolls.
examples.zh: 新西兰寿司店大多数都是反卷寿司。

words.note: 日语 uramaki。California roll 是蟹柳牛油果反卷。

words.zh: 海苔（紫菜片）
words.definition: Thin dried sheets of seaweed used to wrap sushi.

examples.en: Can I have the rice ball without nori?
examples.zh: 饭团可以不要海苔吗？

words.zh: 芥末（日本山葵，绿色辣酱）
words.definition: A very hot green paste served with sushi and sashimi.

examples.en: Go easy on the wasabi — it's strong.
examples.zh: 芥末少放点，很冲。

words.note: 很多餐厅的 wasabi 其实是辣根加色素做的。

words.zh: 寿司姜（腌嫩姜片）
words.definition: Thin slices of sweet pickled ginger, eaten between pieces of sushi to clean your mouth.

examples.en: The pickled ginger is for cleansing the palate.
examples.zh: 寿司姜是用来清口的。

words.note: 日语 gari。

words.zh: 盖饭（日式盖浇饭）
words.definition: A bowl of rice with meat, fish or vegetables on top.

examples.en: Chicken teriyaki donburi with miso soup.
examples.zh: 照烧鸡盖饭配味噌汤。

words.note: 常简称 don，如 katsu don、gyu don。

words.zh: 日式炸猪排/炸鸡排（裹面包糠）
words.definition: A cutlet of pork or chicken coated in panko breadcrumbs and deep-fried.

examples.en: Chicken katsu curry with rice.
examples.zh: 日式炸鸡排咖喱饭。

words.note: tonkatsu 专指炸猪排。

words.zh: 日式面包糠（粗而脆）
words.definition: Light, flaky Japanese breadcrumbs that make food extra crispy.

examples.en: Panko-crumbed prawns.
examples.zh: 日式面包糠炸虾。

words.zh: 日式咖喱（浓稠偏甜）
words.definition: A thick, mild, slightly sweet brown curry sauce, served with rice.

examples.en: Japanese curry is much milder than Indian curry.
examples.zh: 日式咖喱比印度咖喱温和得多。

words.zh: 日式炸鸡块（酱油姜蒜腌）
words.definition: Bite-sized pieces of chicken marinated in soy, ginger and garlic, then deep-fried.

examples.en: Chicken karaage with Japanese mayo.
examples.zh: 日式炸鸡块配日式蛋黄酱。

words.zh: 天妇罗（轻薄面糊炸海鲜蔬菜）
words.definition: Seafood or vegetables dipped in a very light batter and deep-fried.

examples.en: Prawn and vegetable tempura.
examples.zh: 大虾蔬菜天妇罗。

words.zh: 拉面
words.definition: Japanese wheat noodles in a rich meat or fish broth with toppings.

examples.en: Tonkotsu ramen with an extra egg.
examples.zh: 豚骨拉面加一个溏心蛋。

words.zh: 豚骨（猪骨浓汤）
words.definition: A thick, creamy, white ramen broth made by boiling pork bones for hours.

examples.en: The tonkotsu broth is cooked for 18 hours.
examples.zh: 豚骨汤底熬了18个小时。

words.note: 别和 tonkatsu（炸猪排）混淆。

words.zh: 酱油（味）
words.definition: Japanese soy sauce; shoyu ramen has a clear soy-flavoured broth.

examples.en: Shoyu or miso ramen?
examples.zh: 要酱油拉面还是味噌拉面？

words.zh: 味噌（发酵黄豆酱）
words.definition: A salty, savoury paste of fermented soybeans.

examples.en: Miso soup comes with every set.
examples.zh: 每份套餐都配味噌汤。

words.zh: 乌冬面（粗白面）
words.definition: Thick, soft, white wheat noodles.

examples.en: Beef udon in a hot broth.
examples.zh: 热汤牛肉乌冬面。

words.zh: 荞麦面（常冷吃）
words.definition: Thin buckwheat noodles, served hot or cold with a dipping sauce.

examples.en: Cold soba with dipping sauce on a hot day.
examples.zh: 大热天吃冷荞麦面蘸汁。

words.note: 很多荞麦面也含小麦，麸质过敏要问。

words.zh: 日式煎饺
words.definition: Japanese dumplings, pan-fried crispy on one side.

examples.en: Six pork gyoza, please.
examples.zh: 请来六个猪肉煎饺。

words.zh: 毛豆（盐煮）
words.definition: Young green soybeans in their pods, boiled and salted.

examples.en: Edamame with sea salt to start.
examples.zh: 先来一份海盐毛豆。

words.zh: 照烧（甜酱油汁烤）
words.definition: Grilled with a sweet, shiny soy sauce glaze.

examples.en: Salmon teriyaki with rice.
examples.zh: 照烧三文鱼配米饭。

words.zh: 日式烤鸡串
words.definition: Small pieces of chicken on skewers, grilled over charcoal.

examples.en: Yakitori with salt or tare sauce?
examples.zh: 烤鸡串要盐味还是酱汁？

words.zh: 炙烤刺身（表面快速炙烤、中间生）
words.definition: Fish or beef seared quickly on the outside, left raw inside and sliced thinly.

examples.en: Beef tataki with ponzu.
examples.zh: 炙烤牛肉配柚子酱油。

words.zh: 火炙寿司（喷枪炙烤表面）
words.definition: Sushi with the fish lightly flame-seared with a blowtorch.

examples.en: Aburi salmon nigiri with a little mayo.
examples.zh: 炙烤三文鱼握寿司加一点蛋黄酱。

words.zh: 柚子醋酱油（柑橘酱油）
words.definition: A tangy, citrusy soy-based sauce.

examples.en: Kingfish sashimi with ponzu.
examples.zh: 鰤鱼刺身配柑橘醋酱油。

words.zh: 柚子（日本香橙，香气浓）
words.definition: A fragrant Japanese citrus fruit.

examples.en: Yuzu sorbet to finish.
examples.zh: 最后来一份柚子雪葩。

words.zh: 鳗鱼（烤淡水鳗，酱汁甜）
words.definition: Grilled freshwater eel with a sweet, sticky sauce.

examples.en: Unagi don is my favourite.
examples.zh: 鳗鱼饭是我的最爱。

words.zh: 炸豆腐（浸在高汤里）
words.definition: Lightly fried tofu served in a warm, savoury broth.

examples.en: Agedashi tofu is soft inside and crispy outside.
examples.zh: 炸豆腐外脆里嫩。

words.zh: 日式茶碗蒸（蒸蛋羹）
words.definition: A silky, savoury steamed egg custard.

examples.en: The set comes with chawanmushi.
examples.zh: 套餐有一碗茶碗蒸。

words.zh: 日式高汤（昆布、鲣鱼片熬的）
words.definition: A light Japanese stock made from seaweed and dried fish flakes.

examples.en: The broth is a dashi base, so it's not vegetarian.
examples.zh: 汤底是鱼高汤，所以不是素的。

words.zh: 大阪烧（卷心菜煎饼）
words.definition: A savoury pancake of cabbage and batter, topped with sauce, mayo and fish flakes.

examples.en: Okonomiyaki with pork belly.
examples.zh: 五花肉大阪烧。

words.zh: 章鱼小丸子
words.definition: Round balls of batter with octopus inside, topped with sauce and fish flakes.

examples.en: Careful, the takoyaki are hot inside.
examples.zh: 小心，章鱼小丸子里面很烫。

words.zh: 日式便当
words.definition: A Japanese boxed meal with rice, meat or fish and small sides.

examples.en: A teriyaki chicken bento for lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐来一份照烧鸡便当。

words.zh: 居酒屋（日式小酒馆）
words.definition: A casual Japanese bar serving drinks and small shared dishes.

examples.en: Let's go to the izakaya after work.
examples.zh: 下班后去居酒屋吧。

words.zh: 主厨发办（由厨师决定上什么）
words.definition: A meal where you let the chef choose and serve each dish, often sushi.

examples.en: The omakase is twelve courses at the sushi counter.
examples.zh: 寿司吧台的主厨发办有十二道。

words.zh: 铁板烧
words.definition: Meat, seafood and vegetables cooked on a large iron hot plate in front of you.

examples.en: The teppanyaki chef flipped an egg into his hat.
examples.zh: 铁板烧厨师把鸡蛋抛进了帽子里。

words.zh: 涮涮锅（日式涮肉火锅）
words.definition: A Japanese hot pot where you cook thin slices of meat in boiling broth at the table.

examples.en: Shabu-shabu with wagyu slices.
examples.zh: 和牛涮涮锅。

words.zh: 夏威夷生鱼饭（生鱼块拌酱，盛碗）
words.definition: A Hawaiian dish of cubed raw fish in a soy dressing, served in a bowl with rice and toppings.

examples.en: A salmon poke bowl with edamame and avocado.
examples.zh: 三文鱼生鱼饭配毛豆和牛油果。

words.note: 是夏威夷菜，常在日料或轻食店出现。

words.zh: 麻薯/日式糯米团
words.definition: A soft, chewy Japanese rice cake, sometimes filled with ice cream.

examples.en: Matcha mochi ice cream for dessert.
examples.zh: 甜点来抹茶麻薯冰淇淋。

words.zh: 日本清酒
words.definition: Japanese rice wine, served warm or chilled.

examples.en: Would you like your sake hot or cold?
examples.zh: 清酒要热的还是冰的？

words.note: 不读 sayk。

words.zh: 泰式炒河粉（甜酸，配花生和青柠）
words.definition: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, tofu or prawns, bean sprouts and peanuts, sweet and sour.

examples.en: Chicken pad thai, mild please.
examples.zh: 鸡肉泰式炒河粉，微辣。

words.zh: 泰式酱油炒宽河粉
words.definition: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with dark soy sauce, egg and Chinese broccoli.

examples.en: Pad see ew is great if you don't like spicy food.
examples.zh: 不吃辣的话点酱油炒宽粉很好。

words.zh: 醉面（泰式辣炒宽河粉，加罗勒）
words.definition: Spicy stir-fried wide rice noodles with holy basil and chilli; there is no alcohol in it.

examples.en: The drunken noodles are really spicy.
examples.zh: 醉面真的很辣。

words.note: 泰文 pad kee mao。名字有 drunken，但不含酒。

words.zh: 泰式打抛（罗勒辣炒碎肉，配煎蛋饭）
words.definition: Minced meat stir-fried with holy basil and chilli, served on rice with a fried egg.

examples.en: Pork pad kra pao with a crispy fried egg.
examples.zh: 打抛猪肉配脆煎蛋。

words.zh: 绿咖喱（泰式，通常最辣）
words.definition: A Thai coconut curry made with green chillies, often the hottest of the Thai curries.

examples.en: Green curry with chicken and Thai eggplant.
examples.zh: 绿咖喱鸡配泰国茄子。

words.zh: 红咖喱（泰式）
words.definition: A Thai coconut curry made with dried red chillies.

examples.en: Red duck curry with lychee and pineapple.
examples.zh: 荔枝菠萝红咖喱鸭。

words.zh: 马沙文咖喱（温和带甜，有土豆花生）
words.definition: A mild, rich Thai curry with potatoes, peanuts and warm spices.

examples.en: Massaman beef curry is mild enough for the kids.
examples.zh: 马沙文牛肉咖喱对孩子来说不算辣。

words.zh: 帕能咖喱（浓稠，带花生味）
words.definition: A thick, rich Thai red curry with peanut flavour.

examples.en: Panang curry with prawns.
examples.zh: 帕能咖喱大虾。

words.zh: 冬阴功汤（酸辣汤）
words.definition: A hot and sour Thai soup with lemongrass, lime leaves, chilli and usually prawns.

examples.en: Tom yum goong — that's tom yum with prawns.
examples.zh: 冬阴功就是加了虾的酸辣汤。

words.zh: 冬卡汤（椰奶南姜鸡汤）
words.definition: A creamy Thai coconut soup with galangal, lemongrass and chicken.

examples.en: Tom kha gai is milder than tom yum.
examples.zh: 椰奶鸡汤比冬阴功温和。

words.zh: 泰式肉末沙拉（酸辣，配香草和炒米粉）
words.definition: A Thai salad of minced meat with lime, fish sauce, chilli, herbs and toasted rice powder.

examples.en: Chicken larb with sticky rice.
examples.zh: 鸡肉末沙拉配糯米饭。

words.zh: 泰式青木瓜沙拉
words.definition: A spicy, sour salad of shredded green papaya, lime, chilli and peanuts.

examples.en: Som tam can be very spicy — ask for mild.
examples.zh: 青木瓜沙拉可能很辣，可以要求微辣。

words.zh: 沙爹（烤肉串配花生酱）
words.definition: Grilled skewers of meat served with a peanut sauce.

examples.en: Chicken satay skewers to start.
examples.zh: 先来几串沙爹鸡肉。

words.zh: 泰式鱼饼
words.definition: Spicy, springy fried fish patties with lime leaves and green beans, served with sweet chilli sauce.

examples.en: Thai fish cakes with sweet chilli sauce.
examples.zh: 泰式鱼饼配甜辣酱。

words.zh: 糯米饭
words.definition: Rice that becomes soft and sticky when cooked, often eaten by hand.

examples.en: Mango sticky rice for dessert.
examples.zh: 甜点来芒果糯米饭。

words.note: glutinous rice 虽然名字有 glutinous，但不含麸质。

words.zh: 春卷
words.definition: Thin pastry rolled around vegetables or meat and deep-fried.

examples.en: Vegetarian spring rolls with sweet chilli sauce.
examples.zh: 素春卷配甜辣酱。

words.zh: 越南米纸卷（新鲜不炸）
words.definition: Fresh, cold rolls of rice paper filled with noodles, herbs, salad and prawns or meat.

examples.en: Prawn rice paper rolls with peanut sauce.
examples.zh: 鲜虾米纸卷配花生酱。

words.note: 新西兰/澳洲叫 rice paper rolls，美国常叫 summer rolls 或 fresh spring rolls。

words.zh: 越南河粉
words.definition: A Vietnamese soup of flat rice noodles in a clear beef or chicken broth with herbs.

examples.en: A large beef pho with extra herbs.
examples.zh: 大碗牛肉河粉，多加香草。

words.note: 读 fuh（像 fur 不卷舌），不读 foe。

words.zh: 越南法棍三明治
words.definition: A Vietnamese baguette filled with meat, pâté, pickled vegetables, coriander and chilli.

examples.en: A pork belly bánh mì for lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐来一个五花肉越南法棍。

words.note: 菜单常不带声调符号：banh mi。

words.zh: 越南米线（冷拌米线碗）
words.definition: Vietnamese rice vermicelli, often served cold in a bowl with grilled meat, herbs and fish sauce.

examples.en: Bún with lemongrass chicken.
examples.zh: 香茅鸡肉米线。

words.zh: 越南蘸汁（鱼露、青柠、糖、辣椒）
words.definition: A Vietnamese dipping sauce of fish sauce, lime, sugar, garlic and chilli.

examples.en: Pour the nước chấm over the noodles.
examples.zh: 把越南蘸汁浇在米线上。

words.zh: 碎米饭（越南）
words.definition: Fractured rice grains, served with grilled pork in Vietnam.

examples.en: Broken rice with grilled pork chop and egg.
examples.zh: 碎米饭配烤猪排和鸡蛋。

words.note: 越南语 cơm tấm。

words.zh: 越南煎饼（黄色脆薄饼包虾肉豆芽）
